title: Factcheck: UK Conservatives double the ‘cost of net-zero’ after spreadsheet blunder
content:
A booklet published by the UK’s opposition Conservative party includes a “cost of net-zero” that appears to have been doubled by a spreadsheet error.

The “common sense” policy document argues that “what people ultimately want is a government competent enough to solve the problems for which it takes responsibility”.

In a section that says “sophisticat[ed]…modelling” should not be a substitute for “political judgement”, the “Right Way” document disparages various estimates of the cost of net-zero.

The Conservative document then claims – incorrectly – that the government’s official adviser, the Climate Change Committee (CCC), had put the cost of net-zero at close to £1tn. It says:

“In 2020, the CCC estimated that its route to net-zero would cost £957bn.”

In fact, the CCC’s 2020 estimate was exactly half this amount – £478bn – and last year it published a revised figure of £108bn, largely as a result of the falling cost of electric vehicles (EVs).

The Conservative party’s erroneous claim appears to stem from another report that had accidentally added up numbers twice, using a spreadsheet published by the CCC in 2020.

title: Reading For Change: Resources for Place-Based Systems Change
content:
The Place Project was a place-based systems change project in lutruwita/Tasmania. It was funded by the Paul Ramsay Foundation and the Tasmanian Community Fund and auspiced by Burnie Works. From 2024 it brought together people from Burnie, Devonport, kinimathatakinta/George Town, Brighton and Clarence Plains, as well as a multicultural place-based stream. The project wrapped up at the end of September 2026.

We set out to learn what makes place-based work succeed in Tasmania and what each community knows and does in its own way.

We set out to learn what makes place-based work succeed in Tasmania and what each community knows and does in its own way.

The original plan didn’t last long once communities got involved. The project was reshaped by the people in it, through community-hosted Gatherings, rapid co-design sessions and a Sense Making Day. Along the way, people stopped waiting to be asked and started leading.

title: Suomi haluaa jatkaa minkkitarhausta – hakee EU:lta poikkeuslupaa
content:
Maa- ja metsätalousministeriö hakee Suomelle poikkeuslupaa jatkaa minkkitarhausta ensi vuoden jälkeenkin. Ilman poikkeuslupaa minkkitarhaus päättyy siirtymäajan loppuessa koko EU:ssa ensi vuoden elokuussa, koska minkki on määritelty haitalliseksi vieraslajiksi.

Suomi perustelee poikkeuslupahakemustaan sillä, että minkkitarhaus on etenkin Länsi- ja Itä-Suomen maaseudulla tärkeä elinkeino alueilla, jossa työllistymismahdollisuudet ovat muuten rajalliset. Ministeriö perustelee tarhauksen jatkamista Suomen tavoitteella pitää maaseutualueet elinvoimaisina ja asuttuina.

Komissio arvioi hakemuksen ja tekee siitä päätöksen 60 päivän kuluessa, eli viimeistään joulukuun alussa. Suomen hakemuksessa on mukana 134 minkkitarhaa, jotka ovat ilmoittaneet haluavansa jatkaa toimintaansa. Joukossa on sekä toimivia tarhoja että tarhoja, jotka ovat jääneet lintuinfluenssan vuoksi tauolle.

content:
The provision could give the U.S. the power to exclude Chinese ICT suppliers in signatory countries

Originally published on Global Voices

Image remix on Canva by Ihsan Kamil/EngageMedia. Used with permission.

This article, written by Prapasiri “Nan” Suttisome, was first published by EngageMedia, a non-profit media, technology, and culture organization, and an edited version is republished here as part of a content-sharing agreement. It is also part of Global Voices’ October 2026 Spotlight series, “Big Tech and Authoritarianism.” You can support this coverage by donating here.

Around the world, one in every three people has no reliable access to the internet. Unequal access to the internet creates digital divides that can limit civic participation, undermine access to education and healthcare, and deepen inequality. It can also reduce innovation, industrial growth, and economic output. Reducing digital divides is recognized as essential for progress on the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals, as reaffirmed by the more recent Global Digital Compact, 2024.

title: ROVANIEMEN TEATTERIN PENTTI LINKOLA – KALTAISEMME? LÄHTEE LAPIN KIERTUEELLE
content:
Rovaniemen Teatterin – Lapin alueteatterin maakuntakiertue alkaa tiistaina 27. lokakuuta. Kiertue-esityksenä kaudella 2026–2027 nähdään Pentti Linkola – kaltaisemme?

Atro Kahiluodon ja Eeva Putron käsikirjoittama ja Eljas Liinamaan ohjaama teos sai ensi-iltansa Rovaniemen Teatterissa 5. syyskuuta. Lavalla nähdään Henri Haakana, Kirsi Kärnä, Markku Lukka ja Minna Siitonen, joka vastaa myös teoksen musiikin sävellyksestä.

Syksyllä esitys käy yhteensä kymmenessä kiertuekunnassa. Viime vuoden kiertue-esitys Vesisaaren Alma oli yleisömagneetti, jonka myötä lähes kaikki esitykset olivat loppuunmyytyjä. Lapin Alueteatterin kiertueen ensimmäiset esityspaikat ovat Pello, Ylläs ja Sodankylä.

Pentti Linkola – kaltaisemme? pyrkii ymmärtämään Linkolan ajattelua peilaten siitä vastauksia ja työkaluja tähän ristiriitaiseen aikaan muuttuvassa maailmassa. Esitys tarkastelee ennen kaikkea toivoa ja sen menettämistä ja ehdottomuuden inhimillistä hintaa sekä kysyy, millainen on ihmisen suhde luontoon.

title: Teiden varsilla sijaitsevat taimitarhat palvelevat viilennystä kaipaavia daressalaamilaisia – Yrittäjille bisnes on epävarmaa
content:
Riveittäin kukkia, pensaita, nuoria puita ja taimia reunustaa tietä vilkkaassa Mbezi Louisin kaupunginosassa Dar es Salaamissa. Osa kasveista on pakattu pieniin muovipusseihin tai kierrätettyihin vesipulloihin, jotkut ovat jo niin isoja, että ne varjostavat pienempiä kasveja.

David Simon, joka tunnetaan paremmin Ngoshana, kävelee kasvien välissä, tarkistaa niiden kuntoa ja puhuu asiakkaiden kanssa. Muutaman metrin päässä surisee busseja, moottoripyöriä ja autoja.

Ngoshan taimitarha sijaistee lähellä Dar es Salaamiin johtavaa moottoritietä. Hänelle tienvierusta on sekä työpaikka että näyteikkuna. Liiketila on vain lainassa, ja sen ympärillä oleva kaupunki muuttuu jatkuvasti.

”Jotkut ohikulkijat saattavat huomata kasvin ja kysyä hintaa mennessään töihin mutta eivät palaa ostamaan sitä paluumatkalla. Jos kasvi viehättää heitä, joskus he maksavat siitä ja pyytävät minua säilyttämään sitä puolestaan”, hän kertoo.

title: David Byrne’s New Book Explores the Strange Afterlife of Good Ideas: From Vermeer’s Paintings to Roman Concrete & Dark Matter
content: David Byrne will always be most widely known as the co-founder and frontman of Talking Heads. That may count among the greatest possible achievements for any artist — to the minds of many an Open Culture reader, at least — but it must occasionally frustrate the man himself. Talking Heads broke up 35 years ago, but Byrne has only grown more and more productive since, recording his own albums, creating musicals, writing books, putting on PowerPoint presentations, and even designing bike racks. By now, his ideas have stretched so far beyond music that he’s considering the nature of ideas themselves, how they succeed or fail in catching on, and why they go in and out of acceptance over time. Hence his new book Sleeping Beauties: Why Good Ideas Go Dormant and How They Wake Up.

title: Miten yhtenäinen Iso-Britannia on?
content:
Ulkoapäin voi näyttää siltä, että Britannia on yksi yhtenäinen maa, jota johtaa pääministeri Lontoosta. Todellisuudessa saarivaltion eri puolilla haaveillaan itsenäisyydestä.

Maanantaina 14.9.2026 Skotlannin, Walesin ja Pohjois-Irlannin johtajat allekirjoittivat yhteistyösopimuksen, jossa muun muassa todettiin, että Westminsterin, eli Yhdistyneen kuningaskunnan keskushallinnon aika on ohi. Johtajat vaativat perustuslaillisia muutoksia, jotta maat saisivat enemmän valtaa päättää omista asioistaan. Heidän mukaansa keskushallinnon ei pitäisi rajoittaa maiden oikeutta järjestää kansanäänestys itsenäistymisestä.

Yhdistynyt kuningaskunta (eli Britannia) on suvereeni valtio, johon kuuluu neljä maata: Englanti, Wales, Skotlanti ja Pohjois-Irlanti. Englanti on näistä maista selvästi suurin niin väkiluvultaan kuin bruttokansantuotteeltaan: Englannin osuus koko Britannian bruttokansantuotteesta on yli 85 prosenttia, ja noin 85 prosenttia Britannian väestöstä asuu Englannissa.

title: Ny skiva med flöjtensemblen Tuultenpesä förenar musik, minnen och kulturarv
content:
Hemvist är den finsk-svenska flöjtsextetten Tuultenpesäs andra album. Skivans tema kretsar kring frågor om tillhörighet, migration, minne och identitet. Skivan ges ut i samarbete med Finlands svenska folkmusikinstitut.

Tuultenpesäs karakteristiska ljudvärld formas av ett rikt urval flöjter från olika tider och traditioner. Åspipor, Härjedalspipor, Månmarkapipor, honkahuilu-flöjter, blockflöjter och tvärflöjter möter Leena Laitinens sång i musik som rör sig mellan stillhet och rytmisk energi, mellan enkelhet och flerstämmiga klanglandskap.

Materialet på skivan bygger på äldre uppteckningar och arkivinspelningar av finlandssvensk folkmusik. Traditionella melodier och visor från bland annat Oravais, Purmo, Petalax, Korsnäs, Sibbo, Borgå och Mörskom vävs samman med svensk folkmusik och ensemblemedlemmarnas egna kompositioner.

Tuultenpesä grundades 2016 och består av Kristiina Ilmonen, Mimmi Laaksonen, Leena Laitinen, Göran Månsson, Kirsi Ojala och Jonas Simonson. Debutalbumet Vindstilla utkom 2022.

Hemvist publiceras digitalt på bland annat Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Deezer och Pandora samt ges ut på cd. Läs texthäftet här.

title: Save the date och anmäl din programpunkt till Vårmötet 2027
content:
Oväntade och väntade samarbeten som utvecklar museerna och samhället

Museerna har med sin kunskap, sina många kompetenser och sitt höga förtroende en stark position i samhället. Men i en värld som förändras snabbt behöver också museerna utvecklas, öppna för nya perspektiv och hitta nya lösningar tillsammans med andra.

Under Museernas vårmöte i Gävle den 27–29 april 2027 utforskar vi vad som blir möjligt i mötet med andra. Hur kan samarbeten inom museibranschen och med forskning, näringsliv, civilsamhälle, skola, tech, kreativa näringar och offentliga aktörer bidra till innovation, nya publiker och större samhällsnytta? Och hur kan vi samtidigt värna museernas oberoende och trovärdighet?

Genom erfarenheter, goda exempel och nya perspektiv undersöker vi hur mötet med andra kan göra museerna starkare, öppnare och bättre rustade för framtiden.

Var med och bidra med dina erfarenheter och reflektioner! Vi välkomnar programförslag som vill utforska årets tema från olika perspektiv, från olika professioners vardag och som visar på vägen framåt i sektorn. Ta gärna med era samarbetspartners!

title: Vuoden 2026 nuori kliininen tutkija Markus Haapanen: ”Tutkimuksista puuttuvat usein lääkkeitä eniten käyttävät, eli hauraat ja monisairaat ikääntyneet”
content:
Vuoden nuoreksi kliiniseksi tutkijaksi valittu Markus Haapanen on rakentanut vahvan kansainvälisen verkoston, ja hän on julkaissut laajasti geriatrian alan johtavissa kansainvälisissä tiedelehdissä. Lääketeollisuus pitää tutkimustyötä ja siihen kannustamista tärkeänä, sillä vaikuttava tutkimus tuottaa vaikuttavia hoitoja.

Haapanen toimii apulaisprofessorina kliinisen lääketieteen tutkimusyksikössä Oulun yliopistossa, vanhempana tutkijana Folkhälsanin tutkimuskeskuksessa sekä geriatriaan erikoistuvana lääkärinä Vantaa-Keravan hyvinvointialueen kotiin vietävissä lääkäripalveluissa.

”Tuoreena implementaatiolääketieteen professorina Markus Haapanen on tuonut näkyvästi esiin kliinisen tutkimuksen merkitystä niin lääkärikunnan, nuorten tutkijoiden kuin suuren yleisön keskuudessa. Hän on myös edistänyt tutkimuksen arvostusta toimimalla aktiivisena mentorina, tutkijakouluttajana ja esikuvana”, sanoo palkintolautakunnassa toimiva Nuorten Lääkärien Yhdistyksen puheenjohtaja Markus Hautamäki.

title: Anwar Arifin’s Weavers of the Distant Past, Part 1
content:
Anwar Arifin is a doctoral researcher in economic anthropology. As a member of the WORK-IT project, he is currently researching about the historiography of the Ancient Near East, and what kind of assumptions are born from modern social, political, and economic theory that influence the way scholars perceive and produce the history of the Ancient Near East.

How did you end up researching the topic of your book?

I joined the group a bit later than the others. My first idea was to approach the project by tracing the histories of two disciplines: economics and the social sciences, and Ancient Near Eastern studies. At first, I had accepted the conventional view that these were two separate things. Looking into their histories quickly made that assumption hard to sustain.

Turns out the progenitors of these disciplines participated in the same debates about language. Since I'm trained as an anthropologist, I do ethnography as well, and one thing I always notice is that it comes down to a problem of language.

title: AI and the Future of Wikimedia: Reflections from WCNA 2026
content: During a wrap-up session for WikiConference North America 2026, a participant commented that they were glad the conference program hadn’t focused too heavily on AI. While I agree, I also couldn’t help noticing a sense of unease among participants about the rapid developments in generative AI over the past five years and what they mean for the Wikimedia movement. There is broad agreement that AI is here to stay, but there is little clarity about its implications for the projects and the future of Wikimedia. At the same time, I learned a lot about how the movement is adapting to these developments. In this piece, I reflect on what I learned in the AI and Tech track sessions and in conversations with conference participants. I decided to write down my thoughts primarily to help me wrap my head around this complex topic, but I hope it might also help some readers find answers to their questions and get involved in the conversation.

title: Following 404 Media Investigation, Senator Demands Info About White House's License Plate Surveillance Program
content:
In response to a 404 Media investigation, Sen. Ron Wyden is demanding more information about how a federal license plate reader camera program works.

Last month, we reported on the High Intensity Drug Trafficking Area program’s license plate reader database, which mirrors data from city license plate reader programs onto federal databases. The HIDTA program falls under the White House’s Office of National Drug Control Policy, which infamously ran a secretive cell phone data surveillance project called Hemisphere. We reported that HIDTA has now created a complex system for the federal government to obtain license plate data from companies like Flock, Axon, and Motorola via a series of agreements with cities and towns across the country. 

In a letter to Sara Carter, director of the Office of National Drug Control Policy, Wyden said that the office needs to publish a report it commissioned into the privacy practices of several of its surveillance programs, including the license plate reader database.

title: "Entire System of Cornell University Failed Her": Jane Doe Gang Rape Case Enrages Campus Community
content:
University students across the United States held a national day of action in solidarity with “Jane Doe,” the anonymous former student whose lawsuit alleging she was gang-raped by seven Cornell University Chi Phi fraternity members in 2024 has reignited outrage over how campuses and local law enforcement mishandle sexual assault cases and fail survivors. We go to Cornell’s campus in Ithaca, New York, where faculty have introduced a no-confidence resolution against the university administration.

“The number one message that Cornell students have is that Jane Doe’s ordeal is the tip of the iceberg, that there have been many, many other cases where women have been sexually assaulted and raped at Cornell University, and they’re afraid of coming forward. They’re afraid of going to the authorities because the investigation may be botched or they may be shamed,” says Paul Ortiz, a professor of labor history and the lead sponsor of the resolution.

title: Wikimedia Spain is holding its Annual Conference in Zamora to highlight the value of local knowledge
content:
This weekend, Zamora served as a meeting point to discuss free knowledge, heritage and open culture. The 12th Annual Wikimedia Spain Conference brought together, over three days at the Ethnographic Museum of Castile and León (MECyL), volunteers from the Wikimedia community, professionals from the fields of culture and heritage, teachers, researchers, institutions and members of the public with an interest in open culture. 

The event was attended by around fifty people, who over the course of these three days were able to share their experiences, knowledge and reflections on free knowledge and open culture. 

Under the slogan “Free knowledge is built from the territory”, the conference focused on the role of communities and local areas in building knowledge that is accessible to everyone. 

A significant proportion of the knowledge generated in cities and regions has yet to be documented, verified and shared online. Heritage, traditions, local histories, people and institutions are all sources of knowledge that can help to expand and improve the content available on projects such as Wikipedia.

    • Pro-Kremlin FIMI campaigns promoted four narratives to justify Russia’s war against Ukraine: that Russia only strikes civilian infrastructure in retaliation; that recent attacks around Kyiv ended Moscow’s supposed restraint; that Russian attacks on Ukrainian data centres are part of a “fight against Nazism” in Europe; and that NATO is preparing an offensive or blockade of Kaliningrad.

    These claims ignore extensive evidence of Russian attacks on civilians and civilian infrastructure, as well as documented war crimes. They also distort the chronology and the causes of the war. By blaming Ukraine, denying Russian wrongdoing, and weaponising heavily distorted Second World War narratives, pro-Kremlin actors seek to legitimise Russia’s aggression and portray Moscow as the victim and protector of Europe.

title: Detained Without a Court Ruling: Malikeh Haghighat Remains in Legal Limbo at Gorgan Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Malikeh (Fatemeh) Haghighat, a resident of Gorgan, remains in detention.

Based on information received by HRANA, Ms. Haghighat has been held in Gorgan Prison for 80 days, and her legal case remains unresolved. A source close to her family confirmed this information to HRANA, stating: “She faces charges including propaganda against the regime, and no court hearing has yet been held to address the accusations against her.”

The informed source added that her online activities, including publishing content on social media, are among the grounds cited for the charges brought against her.

Malikeh (Fatemeh) Haghighat, 29, was arrested on July 22, 2026, after appearing at the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office in Gorgan and was subsequently transferred to the city’s prison. Prior to her arrest, she had received an official summons ordering her to appear before the judicial authority.

title: We Are Already Post-Human
content:
From Silicon Valley to the Vatican, across kitchen tables and in the halls of power, the world is astir over the question of whether humans will be able to control the AIs we’ve created. But that begs the question: What does it mean to be “human”?

One place to start sorting this all out is what Confucian philosophy calls “rectification” — naming things for what they actually are.

To N. Katherine Hayles, author of “Bacteria to AI: Human Futures with our Non-human Symbionts,” we are already “post-human.”

As she explained to Claire Webb in a recent Futurology podcast, the concept of “human” is culturally and historically contingent. These days, she says, there is still the dominant view that arose with the Enlightenment of the human as an autonomous, singular entity with “rational free will.”

For Hayles, that has never been true because humans have never existed as an entity apart but have always been “woven in the web” of a surrounding environment, or “Umwelt.” It is the symbiotic interactions within that interdependence which determine the signs we sense, the meaningful interpretation of the information we process, the decisions we make, and the actions we take that define who we are.

title: Montenegro Arrests then Expels Russian 'Rybar' Network Leader, Associates
content:
Montenegrin authorities detained on Friday five persons believed to be the leaders of the Russian media and influence network "Rybar," which Western security agencies view as a sophisticated tool for Kremlin influence operations.

Prime Minister Milojko Spajić framed the action in a post on X as a national security and foreign interference operation.

Spajić noted his government had previously warned of "attempts at hybrid action and destabilization of Montenegro" as the nation pursues European Union integration. Cautioning against "hasty statements," the Prime Minister stated that "serious indications" require every lead to be thoroughly investigated within a broader security context.

"Institutions are doing their job, Montenegro is protecting its interests, and no one will endanger our European future," Spajić wrote.

Montenegrin daily Vijesti cited the Montenegrin Police Directorate as stating the arrests were carried out with the support of "international partners" in order to neutralize illegal activities.

title: New York Plans Stronger Sports Betting Regulation to Curb Gambling Addiction
content:
Gambling regulators in New York on Friday formally proposed two rules that they say will help curb gambling addiction in the state.

The move adds the country’s largest sports betting market to a growing list of places that are seeking online gambling reforms as states that have legalized wagering on sports in recent years deal with the harmful side effects, including rising addiction diagnoses there.

While the drafts have been months in the making, their official introduction follows mounting media scrutiny, including a ProPublica investigation last month that showed weaknesses in the guardrails that companies like DraftKings have erected to address problem gamblers on their platforms. That system is called “responsible gaming.”

The commission’s chair, Brian O’Dwyer, said that the proposed rules “provide an opportunity for the industry to illustrate its commitment” to protecting its customers. 

“The industry is on notice by me and this commission that they need to solve this problem,” O’Dwyer said. “If the industry does not address it, then we will address it and they may not like the solution that we come up with.”

title: Asikkalan aarteet ja paikallistarinoiden voima
content:
Lokakuussa 2024 lähetin kirjastonjohtajallemme ehdotuksen:

“Ehdotan että Asikkalan kirjasto käynnistää hankkeen, jossa tallennetaan paikallisten asukkaiden kertomia elämäntarinoita tehtyjen haastattelujen avulla. Nämä tarinat julkaistaan äänipodcastina, kaikkien kuunneltavaksi verkkoon. Hankkeen tavoitteena on kerätä ja säilyttää Asikkalan alueen kulttuuriperintöä sekä tarjota asukkaille mahdollisuus jakaa omia elämäntarinoitaan ja muistojaan laajemman yleisön kanssa, sekä tutustua paikallisten vivahteikkaisiin vaiheisiin.”

Ajatus tähän kumpusi omasta kokemuksestani. Olin aiemmin löytänyt digitoidun kasettikirjeen sekä videotallenteita, joissa nyttemmin jo edesmenneet isovanhempani kertoivat elämästään ja vaiheistaan esimerkiksi sodassa. Niiden kuunteleminen herätti paljon muistoja. Samalla tajusin, miten arvokkaita tällaiset tallenteet voivatkaan olla.

title: Markku Tannerin muistoseminaarissa katsottiin rohkeasti tulevaan
content:
Kotiseutuliiton pitkäaikaisen toiminnanjohtajan Markku Tannerin elämäntyötä kunnioitettiin 8. lokakuuta Helsingissä Karjalatalolla järjestetyssä muistoseminaarissa. Lämminhenkisessä tilaisuudessa muisteltiin Tannerin mittavia ansioita suomalaisen kotiseututyön hyväksi, mutta samalla suunnattiin katse tulevaisuuteen: kotiseututyö nähtiin ennen kaikkea yhteisöjen, luottamuksen ja turvallisuuden rakentamisena.

Tilaisuuteen kokoontui monikymmenpäinen joukko Tannerin perheenjäseniä, ystäviä, työtovereita, kotiseututoimijoita, yhteistyökumppaneita sekä hänen työnsä jatkajia. Muistoseminaarin puheenvuorot luotasivat Tannerin elämäntyötä kolmesta näkökulmasta: karjalaisuus, kaupunkilaisuus ja yhteisöllisyys. Esiin nousivat sekä Tannerin poikkeuksellinen työura että hänen merkittävä vaikutuksensa suomalaisen kotiseututyön kehittämiseen. Tilaisuudessa kuultiin niin läheisten, tutkijoiden, nuorten toimijoiden kuin eri järjestöjenkin edustajien näkemyksiä hänen elämäntyöstään.

title: Readying the Nordics for War – Let’s Not Waste Time
content:
The Russian threat rises and rises. The risks and costs from its shadow (and sometimes open) attacks are increasing, and at some point soon there will be a serious crisis, perhaps brought on by the casualties from a successful version of the Kremlin’s bungled strike at Leipzig Airport in August.

Facing this, Europe’s most aware and best-prepared countries are represented by the Baltic states and the Nordic nations of Norway, Denmark, Sweden and Finland. They have been spending and reorganizing at speed since Russia’s all-out invasion of Ukraine, as has Germany.

With France and the UK, the continent’s traditional security heavyweights, hamstrung by enormous debt loads and seemingly unable to make decisive increases in defense spending, and the US now focused elsewhere, the Nordic countries cannot expect others to provide leadership.

They should take the next step toward a unified fighting system. Major work is already underway. Nordic troops are now in Finland, as well as the Baltics, while the Nordic Airpower Concept (NAPC), which offers a unified command over more than 250 modern combat aircraft, started operations early last year.

title: Youth.Heritage.Europe. brings youth voices to third Policy Debate on responsible tourism and heritage
content:
How can cultural tourism support heritage conservation without placing additional pressure on the places and communities it celebrates? This question guided Youth.Heritage.Europe.’s third Youth Policy Debate, organised within the frame of the EU-funded European Heritage Hub.

With welcoming remarks from Jasna Popović, Secretary of Youth.Heritage.Europe, and a panel moderated by Sophia Dibbs, Youth.Heritage.Europe.’s Programmes Officer, the event on 30 September 2026 brought together Chiara Ronchini, Theo Alexandridis, Daphne Gerodimou, and Andrea Bringas to discuss responsible tourism and the role of young people in shaping heritage practices.

The discussion explored the tensions between attracting visitors, protecting heritage, and maintaining the quality of life of local residents. Theo Alexandridis, one of the Hub’s NextGen Heritage Ambassadors, outlined environmental deterioration, physical damage, and social displacement associated with overtourism. Examples from Barcelona, Venice, Amsterdam, and Dubrovnik illustrated how destinations are responding through visitor management and restrictions on cruise tourism.

title: Ylioppilaslehden Ideakilpailun finalistit on valittu
content:
”No kyllä täältä kelpaa tuomaroida”, todettiin, kun Ylioppilaslehden ideakilpailun tuomaristo eli Esa Mäkinen, Vappu Kaarenoja, Antti Pikkanen ja Veikko Eranti kokoontui Sanomatalon ylimmän kerroksen kokoushuoneeseen aurinkoisena keskiviikkoiltapäivänä. Edessä oli tärkeä tehtävä: valita kilpailutöiden joukosta ne ehdotukset, jotka kutsutaan finaaliin tavoittelemaan 1 000 euron pääpalkintoa.

Tunnelma oli odotettavissa olevista vaikeista päätöksistä huolimatta hyvä. Ideakilpailu on ensimmäinen laatuaan, eikä kukaan rehellisesti ottaen täysin tiennyt, mitä siltä odottaa. Siksi tuomareita ilahduttivat ehdotusten määrä ja korkea taso sekä se, kuinka samoja haasteita lähestyttiin hyvin erilaisista näkökulmista.

Kilpailutöissä nousi esiin erityisesti opiskelijoiden ja Ylioppilaslehden välinen suhde. Monissa ehdotuksissa pohdittiin, miten yhteisöllisyyttä voitaisiin vahvistaa ja miten lehti voisi tulla lähemmäs opiskelijoiden arkea. Ehdotuksissa käsiteltiin myös uusia kumppanuusmalleja, yhteisöjournalismia, monimediaalisia sisältöjä sekä muuttuvia mediankäyttötapoja ja opiskelijoiden informaatiokuormaa.

title: Hallitus on etsinyt helpotusta polttoaineiden hintakriisiin – ”Nyt olisi aika tehdä päätöksiä”
content:
Hallitus on neuvotellut pitkään keinoista, joilla se voisi tukea korkeista polttoaineiden hinnoista kärsiviä yksityishenkilöitä ja yrittäjiä. Ympäristö- ja ilmastoministeri Sari Multala (kok.) kertoi jo torstaina, että keinoista olisi olemassa aika pitkälti sopu, mutta vaikeus on siinä, mistä otetaan rahat.

Hallituksen keinot puuttua polttoaineiden pumppuhintoihin ovat vähissä, koska rahaa ei juurikaan ole käytettävissä. Haussa ovat olleet erityisesti ratkaisut, joilla voi tukea paljon työkseen tai työnsä vuoksi ajavia, kuljetusalan yrittäjiä ja maatalousyrittäjiä.

Pääministeri Petteri Orpo (kok.) on toivonut ratkaisuja tällä viikolla. Lähteet eri hallituspuolueista pitivät aamupäivästä mahdollisena, että valmista olisi voinut tulla perjantaina, mutta iltapäivään mennessä mitään ei kuulunut.

- Olemme tehneet useita ratkaisuehdotuksia. Nyt olisi aika tehdä päätöksiä, Orpo kommentoi toimittajille eduskunnassa perjantaina.

Hän sanoi, ettei itse istu neuvottelupöydässä. Asia on erityisavustajien käsissä.

title: Subsea cables and oil pipelines: The infrastructure linking AI, empire, and occupation
content:
Internet infrastructure policy is increasingly a topic of discussion in military strategy and policy decision-making

Originally published on Global Voices

Screenshot of the Internet Infrastructure Map in 2026, from kmcd.dev. Fair use

By Alli Armijo

This post is part of Global Voices’ October 2026 Spotlight series, “Big Tech and Authoritarianism.” In this Spotlight, we explore how Big Tech facilitates and hinders authoritarian governments and practices, and how these choices influence the Global South. You can support this coverage by donating here.

The internet has always been illusive. Stretching bodies of water, screens, and time zones, it exists in a plurality increasingly shaped by big tech. And the cables mediate this; the cables are its nervous system.

With over 600 active and planned underwater internet cables spanning over 1.5 million kilometers around the globe, the majority of subsea infrastructure is predominantly owned and operated by US tech monopolies, namely Google, Amazon, Meta and Microsoft. 

This infrastructure is largely laid on trans-Atlantic slave ship and oil extraction routes, algorithmically bound by a legacy of colonial violence and exploitative labor practices.

title: Peruskoulun voima on sen hitaudessa
content:
Peruskoulussa opetetaan perustietoja ja -taitoja, jotka muuttuvat hitaasti, vaikka tieteenalat kehittyvät. Esimerkiksi matematiikan opiskelu on jatkossakin luontevaa aloittaa peruslaskutoimituksista, vaikka matematiikka tieteen alana kehittyy koko ajan.

Koulutusjärjestelmämme pohjaa ajatukseen, että sen huipulla on alansa uusimpaan ja parhaimpaan tietoon pohjautuva korkeakoulutus. Tasapainoilu alkuopetuksen liikkumattoman lähtöpisteen ja alati kauemmas karkaavan korkeakoulutuksen välillä on tuttua peruskoulun ylemmillä luokilla ja toisen asteen opinnoissa. Missään kohdassa ei saisi tulla liian isoa loikkaa, jotta kukin ikäluokka pysyy opinnoissa mukana. 

Toisaalta pitäisi huolehtia, että peruskoululaiset ovat valmiita siirtymään toisen asteen ammatillisiin tai lukio-opintoihin, ja toisaalta siitä, että toisen asteen opinnot antavat riittävät valmiudet korkeakouluun. Tämän yhtälön pyörittäminen on osa koulutus- ja tiedeyhteisön perusarkea ja rullaa omalla painollaan. Opetussuunnitelmia tehdään ja oppimateriaaleja päivitetään.

title: USA: Livestreaming firing squad execution would compound cruelty of the death penalty
content:
Responding to the announcement that the Trump administration has set the first military execution since 1961, and that the execution will be carried out by firing squad and livestreamed to the public, Justin Mazzola, Deputy Director of Research at Amnesty International USA, said:

“The announcement by the Trump administration that it has set the first military execution in more than six decades is reprehensible and showcases the inherent arbitrariness of the death penalty and the authorities’ utter disregard for the right to life.

“The death penalty is a violation of human rights, no matter what. International human rights bodies have long found public executions as incompatible with the prohibition on cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment. The claim that the death penalty serves as a greater deterrent is simply unfounded: there is no evidence that it has a unique deterrent effect. The death penalty does not make us safer.

“Livestreaming the taking of a life by firing squad would only compound the cruelty of the death penalty and perpetuate the cycle of violence that the authorities purportedly seek to end.

title: Navi Pillay, South African Jurist, Wins Nobel Peace Prize in "Stinging Rebuke to Donald Trump"
content:
The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize has been awarded to Navanethem “Navi” Pillay, the South African jurist who led the United Nations commission of inquiry that concluded that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Pillay’s long career in international human rights law includes work as a defense attorney for anti-apartheid activists, president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, a former judge at the International Criminal Court and the U.N.’s high commissioner for human rights from 2008 to 2014.

“Everybody in the human rights movement reveres Navi Pillay,” says war crimes prosecutor Reed Brody, who calls the award “a stinging rebuke to Donald Trump.” Brody, a member of the United Nations Group of Human Rights Experts on Nicaragua, also comments on the Trump administration’s decision to deport a Nicaraguan opposition activist, Jeffrey Jarquín, from the United States, where he was in the process of seeking asylum. Upon his return to Nicaragua, Jarquín was immediately imprisoned at the same facility in which he was once tortured.

title: A Journey to the Language Diversity Conference 2026 in Accra, Ghana
content:
Languages are more than tools for communication. They carry memory, humour, belief and identity from one generation to the next. For those of us who belong to communities whose languages are barely visible online, the question of how to keep them alive in the digital age is not abstract; it is personal and urgent. It was with this question in mind that I travelled to Accra, Ghana, for the Language Diversity Conference 2026, held from 2 to 4 October.

The conference was themed “Strengthening Language Communities in the Open Knowledge Movement.” It is a global gathering dedicated to advancing linguistic diversity within the Wikimedia community and the wider open movement. Bringing together editors, researchers, language advocates and institutional partners, it offered a rare space for communities working on under-resourced languages to learn from one another and to be heard. I was fortunate to attend as a scholarship recipient of the Wikimedia Foundation, after a highly competitive application process that opened in early 2026. This essay is my account of the journey, the sessions that shaped me, and what I carry back to my own community.

title: Annual Report on Execution in Iran; Marking the World Day Against the Death Penalty
content:
HRANA – Marking the World Day Against the Death Penalty, the Statistics Center of Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRA) has released its annual report on the use of capital punishment in Iran. The findings point to a sharp intensification in executions, continued secrecy surrounding implementation of death sentences, and an increase in political and security-related executions.

Between October 10, 2025 and October 8, 2026, HRANA documented at least 2,003 executions across Iran on the basis of 1,857 reports, an increase of approximately 29% compared with the previous reporting period. During the same period, 230 people were documented as having been sentenced to death. The full report also includes detailed statistical analysis, profiles of political and security-related executions, and documentation concerning judicial officials involved in issuing or upholding death sentences.

title: War’s Hidden Mental Health Toll on Children with Disabilities
content:
As armed conflicts proliferate around the globe, World Mental Health Day is a reminder that the psychological toll stemming from hostilities result in mental health harms that have lasting effects on people’s lives. Insecurity, trauma, anxiety, and confusion are the norm for many who have endured armed conflict.

Access to services is frequently inadequate—even though over a fifth of conflict-affected populations are estimated to experience mental health conditions such as post-traumatic stress, depression or anxiety. For people, including children, with intellectual disabilities, these harms can be compounded by social, attitudinal, and environmental barriers, which interact with their disability and can heighten their exposure to violence and exclusion.

title: Kidnappings and Home Invasions Soar as French Syndicates Extort Crypto
content:
A father beaten and forced into a car trunk. A magistrate and her mother held hostage for 30 hours. A family terrorized overnight in northern France for digital cash. Over the past two years, a violent wave of kidnappings and home invasions has swept across France targeting cryptocurrency executives, influencers, and their loved ones, as criminal networks increasingly turn to physical torture to extort digital fortunes.

Organized criminal networks increasingly turn to home invasions, physical torture, and abductions to extort digital fortunes. Authorities have recorded 77 such incidents so far this year, up from 67 in 2025 and roughly 20 in 2024, according to data from France’s National Prosecutor’s Office for Organized Crime, known as PNACO.

While the early wave of violence primarily targeted high-profile industry executives and wealthy influencers, law enforcement officials warn that criminal syndicates are increasingly hunting ordinary citizens suspected of holding digital wallets. Just weeks ago, four armed intruders held a family captive overnight in the northern town of Vendin-le-Vieil, forcing the father to hand over about 40,000 euros, or $47,000, in cryptocurrency.

title: The Pentagon Gave $350 Million in Contracts to a Firm Closely Tied to a Senior Defense Department Official
content:
Among a cadre of Wall Street executives brought into the Pentagon during President Donald Trump’s second term, George K. Kollitides II has emerged as a powerbroker with a broad mandate to improve procurement of weapons and critical minerals.

The longtime partner at the private equity firm Alvarez & Marsal Capital has framed his tour of duty in government as a service to the country. But the work he’s leading has also been a boon to his old friends in the private sector, government procurement records show.

In April, months after Kollitides had started work at the Pentagon, he was listed on a securities filing as continuing to work for his old company as a senior adviser. Two months later, the Defense Department finalized a $281 million no-bid consulting contract with an affiliate firm, Alvarez & Marsal Federal, to advise Kollitides’ new Pentagon office, the records show.

title: Putin and Xi United by a Love of Corruption
content:
Countries in Eastern Europe and Central Asia are among the world’s worst for corruption, with widespread impunity driven by the vested interests that dominate many of their governments.

Western European nations fill nine places in the list of the best 10 countries globally in Transparency International’s Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI), but the continent’s anti-corruption efforts have largely stalled in recent years, with the region’s average CPI score dropping quicker than in any other region.

Of the 182 countries ranked in the latest CPI, published in February, the top ranks included Denmark in first place, with Finland and Singapore second and third, while those perceived as the most corrupt included Venezuela at 180th and South Sudan and Somalia tied at 181st.

title: Anja Snellmanille Aleksis Kiven palkinto

Kirjailija Anja Snellmanille on myönnetty Aleksis Kiven palkinto. Palkinnon jakaa Suomalaisen Kirjallisuuden Seura (SKS), ja se on suuruudeltaan 25 000 euroa.

Palkintolautakunta perusteli Snellmanin valintaa sillä, että hän on vuosikymmeniä jatkuneen uransa aikana sykähdyttänyt suomalaista kirjallisuus- ja kulttuurielämää sekä taiteilijana että yhteiskunnallisena vaikuttajana, SKS:n tiedotteessa kerrotaan.

Snellman on kirjoittanut muun muassa romaaneja, tietokirjoja ja elokuvakäsikirjoituksia. Hänen teoksiaan on käännetty noin 20 kielelle.

Aleksi Kiven palkinto jaetaan kolmen vuoden välein. Kyseessä on elämäntyöpalkinto, jota on jaettu vuodesta 1936 asti. Palkinto jaetaan kaikki kaunokirjallisuuden lajit huomioon ottaen.

title: Riihisaari Blues soi ja piristää Savonlinnassa marraskuussa
content:
Ainutlaatuinen Savonlinnan museon oma bluesmusiikin festivaali järjestetään tänä vuonna jo kuudetta kertaa. Marraskuun toisena viikonloppuna luvassa on taattua musiikillista museotunnelmaa 174-vuotiaassa Riihisaaren tiilimakasiinissa, Olavinlinnan kansallismaisemassa. Odotettu bluestapahtuma levittäytyy tänä vuonna Riihisaaren museon lisäksi myös muualle Savonlinnaan. Tapahtuma on osa Savonlinnan Kulttuurin unelmavuotta.

Yksi maamme omaleimaisimmista musiikkitapahtumista, Savonlinnan museon oma Riihisaari Blues jatkaa musiikillista taivaltaan. Savonlinnan Riihisaaressa, Olavinlinnan kansallismaisemassa järjestettävä tapahtuma on jo vakiintunut tärkeäksi osaksi itäisen Suomen syyskauden tapahtumatarjontaa.

Bluesmusiikkia tuodaan tänä vuonna Riihisaaren museon lisäksi myös muualle kaupunkiin, kuten Nälkälinnanmäen Kulttuuritaloon, Savonlinnan Kulttuurikellariin ja Savonlinnan kaupungintalolle. Lisäksi viikon aikana bluesia tullaan kuulemaan minikonserteissa eri paikoissa ympäri kaupunkia.

title: Bringing single-cell dataset completeness into focus
content:
Over the past decade, single-cell sequencing has revolutionized biological research, enabling scientists to investigate tissues at unprecedented resolution. Large-scale cellular atlases now contain millions of cells, offering increasingly detailed descriptions of human tissues, developmental processes and diseases.

While considerable effort has been devoted to increasing dataset sizes, improving sequencing technologies and discovering new cell populations, surprisingly little attention has been paid to a fundamental challenge of these studies: dataset incompleteness.

A single-cell dataset can only describe the cells that were successfully sampled. Rare cell populations may remain undetected, and even datasets containing millions of cells cannot automatically be considered sufficient representations of the underlying tissue. Nevertheless, the question of how much cellular diversity remains undiscovered has rarely been explicitly addressed or quantified in single-cell biology.

title: India: Delhi police must facilitate right to peaceful protest amid lockdown-like restrictions in capital
content:
Responding to the sweeping and disproportionate restrictions imposed by the Delhi Police and the Government of India ahead of planned protests in the capital on Saturday 10 October, Aakar Patel, Chair of Board, Amnesty International India, said: 

“Peaceful protesters must be able to demand accountability from those in power without facing intimidation, arbitrary detention, or sweeping restrictions on their freedoms. 

“From denying permission for a peaceful demonstration, halting all Delhi-bound trains, and sealing the city’s borders, to issuing an internet suspension order near the protest site, and pre-emptively arresting activists – India’s authorities are leaving no stone unturned in their bid to prevent this march from happening. The right to protest is protected in India’s constitution. The authorities must immediately lift all these arbitrary restrictions, which violate India’s obligations under international law. Demonstrations should not depend on obtaining prior permission from the police. At most, organizers may be expected to notify the authorities of their plans.

title: "Abolish ICE": Protests Erupt in NYC After ICE Agents Shoot Father with 5-Year-Old Son in Car
content:
Protests have erupted in New York City after a federal immigration agent shot and wounded a man in the Bronx on Thursday afternoon. As masked agents reportedly posing as construction workers attempted to arrest 28-year-old Oscar Belgal, they opened fire on his car. Belgal was shot in the neck. His 5-year-old child, who was in the back seat, was physically unharmed. Belgal was taken to a local hospital, where hundreds, including our guests, Democratic congressional candidate Darializa Avila Chevalier and New York City Councilmember Carmen De La Rosa, gathered to demand his release.

“What we saw yesterday was a prime example of why [ICE] is a terror to our communities, why it should not exist,” says Avila Chevalier. She was among multiple people assaulted by officers with the NYPD unit that specializes in protest policing, known as the Strategic Response Group (SRG). Four others were arrested at Thursday evening’s protest. Avila Chevalier, who was knocked down to the ground by officers, says, “This is why we also must demand that we get rid of and disband the SRG, because this type of response should have never happened for folks who were just simply trying to protect their neighbor.”

title: Lithuanian Minister Condemns Intimidation Campaign against Investigative Reporters
content:
Lithuanian Culture Minister Lukas Alsys condemned the harassment of journalists and editors on Thursday after being asked about growing pressure on 15min staff following the news outlet’s joint investigation with OCCRP into the crypto-finance firm Bankera.

“Any persecution of journalists or editors aimed at intimidating or frightening them is completely intolerable,” Alsys told Žinių Radijas, adding that relevant authorities should “draw conclusions.”

The joint investigation revealed that more than 45 million euros raised during Bankera’s 2017–2018 token sale was transferred to Pacific Private Bank in Vanuatu, an offshore entity acquired by Bankera’s three co-founders. Records showed the bank subsequently issued millions of euros in loans to the founders and their companies, including funds used to purchase luxury real estate.

Lithuania’s Financial Crime Investigation Service opened a pre-trial investigation shortly after the story was published in April 2025. Vanuatu’s central bank later revoked Pacific Private Bank’s international license, though the decision was stayed pending appeal.

What followed was a systematic campaign of pressure targeting journalists and executives at 15min.

title: Ken Paxton’s Security for Travel Cost Taxpayers Millions. Just 1 in 6 of His Trips Had a Stated Business Purpose.
content:
In the summer of 2023, after he was impeached on charges of abusing his office for personal gain, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton was suspended and barred from conducting any official business for more than three months while awaiting trial in the state Senate.

So, he traveled.

Paxton, a Republican who is now running for U.S. Senate, took at least 17 trips over three months, including to resort destinations Park City, Utah, and Vail, Colorado. He visited the Oklahoma town where he owns a vacation lodge and a Utah community with a golf resort, where he later bought four condominiums.

State police joined him each time, costing taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars for trips unrelated to his job as attorney general. The Texas Senate ultimately acquitted him on the impeachment charges.

But Paxton’s use of the taxpayer-funded detail did not begin or end there. In fact, it stands out compared with his predecessor, fellow elected officials in Texas and other state attorneys general, ProPublica and The Texas Tribune found.

title: Trust Is as Important to NATO as Guns
content:
The alliance cannot sustain collective defense if its citizens doubt why it exists, distrust what it says, or come to believe it is responsible for the threats it confronts. Public trust in NATO should be seen as a key part of Europe’s security infrastructure.

Societal trust is crucial to countering Russia in the information sphere, which is where the narrative battles take place. For NATO members, these battles matter because public acceptance of Moscow’s false claim that the West caused the war could weaken support for Ukraine and for the alliance’s broader deterrence mission.

Polling in all 32 NATO member states suggests this matters. In a survey conducted across the alliance, respondents who trusted NATO were far more likely to blame Russia for starting the war; people with greater faith in the alliance were nearly three times more likely to blame Russia and had about 65% lower odds of blaming the West and Ukraine, compared to those who did not.

The results revealed that distrust in supranational and alliance institutions is strongly associated with West blame.

title: PAMin puheenjohtaja pyrkii kansanedustajaksi – ”Vaikuttamisen paikka ja tarve on nyt eduskunnassa”
content:
Palvelualojen ammattiliitto PAMin puheenjohtaja Annika Rönni-Sällinen lähtee SDP:n ehdokkaaksi kevään eduskuntavaaleihin. Hän toivoo pääsevänsä vaikuttamaan eduskunnassa muun muassa työelämään liittyviin asioihin.

Rönni-Sällistä on pyydetty ehdolle aikaisemminkin, mutta vielä silloin aika ei ollut kypsä – hän koki voivansa vaikuttaa hänelle tärkeisiin asioihin paremmin ammattiliitossa. Nyt tilanne on muuttunut.

– Vaikuttamisen paikka ja tarve on nyt siellä eduskunnassa. Tällä hallituskaudella on tuntunut siltä, että työelämään liittyvistä asioista päätetään entistä enemmän siellä. Asiat, mistä on pystytty aikaisemmin neuvottelemaan, ovat siirtyneet poliitikkojen käsiin, hän sanoo Demokraatille.

Uudeltamaalta ehdolle lähtevä Annika Rönni-Sällinen, 50, pitää tärkeänä, että eduskunnassa käsiteltäisiin myös työelämän kehittämistä.

– Tuntuu, että työelämän kehittämisen näkökulmia ei poliitikoilla ole lainkaan. Meidän täytyisi enemmän miettiä, miltä työelämä näyttää, kun siihen vaikuttavat nämä kaikki suuret murrokset – digitalisaatio, tekoäly, ilmastonmuutos, Rönni-Sällinen luonnehtii.

title: The best sunrise alarm clocks in the UK, tried and tested for gentler mornings
content:
Our reviewer sheds some light on the best dawn simulation alarms, from Lumie and Philips to Dreamegg

• The best eye masks to help you sleep better

To wake each day in darkness is a plight you wouldn’t wish on your worst enemy, yet that’s what many of us do routinely throughout winter. Getting up in the dark decouples our life from our circadian rhythm (our body clock), with bodily processes such as cognition and metabolism put to work before they’re fully prepped.

Thank heavens, then, for sunrise alarm clocks. These “dawn simulation” devices glow with gradually intensifying brightness as your wake-up time approaches, kickstarting your circadian rhythm before you get out of bed. For many users, this results in a happier, healthier start to the day.

title: Värdena påverkar om renoverad elektronik köps
content:
Konsumenters uppfattningar om återuppbyggda elektroniska produkter baseras ofta mer på känslor än på kunskap om deras faktiska egenskaper. Därför bör bilderna som är kopplade till begagnade och senare renoverade produkter modifieras för att passa olika konsumentgrupper.

SuFiRe-projektet, koordinerat av Åbo yrkeshögskola, undersökte affärsstudenters attityder till ombyggda elektroniska produkter. Totalt deltog 270 studenter från Finland, Sverige och Ungern i studien.

Återuppbyggda elektroniska produkter, det vill säga elektroniska produkter som har samlats in och renoverats vid användning, blir allt vanligare som en del av cirkulära ekonomin. De kan spara upp till 80 procent av materialen jämfört med att tillverka en helt ny. Ändå är många konsumenter fortfarande tveksamma.

Värderingar är viktigare än nationalitet

Enligt en internationell studie är värderingar en nyckelfaktor som förklarar attityder till återuppbyggda elektroniska produkter, vilket å andra sidan ger en lovande grund för att främja hållbar konsumtion i Europa.

title: USA: Trump’s attack on the ICC demands a global response of resistance and protection
content:
With its sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC) as an institution, the US Administration seeks to destroy the Court and extinguish any prospect of justice for perpetrators of grave crimes under international law, Amnesty International said today. States must take every appropriate measure to resist this attack and actively protect the Court.

“President Trump’s sanctions are designed to isolate and ultimately destroy the International Criminal Court. This existential attack must fail. States must take concrete action to resist the imposition of these measures and actively protect the Court,” said Erika Guevara Rosas, Amnesty International’s Senior Director for Research, Policy, Advocacy and Campaigns.

title: IKEA Stopped Selling in Russia. But its Former Belarusian Supplier Filled the Gap — With Strikingly Similar Furniture
content:
When the Swedish furniture giant IKEA exited Russia and Belarus in 2022 in response to the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, it instructed its suppliers to do the same. A Lithuanian supplier complied, and stopped sourcing IKEA products from its Belarusian factory.

But the Belarusian factory didn’t stop exporting furniture after losing the rights to IKEA designs. Instead, it appears to have filled an IKEA-shaped void in the Russian market, exporting pieces that are strikingly similar to the Swedish designs.

The website of one Russian retailer even told customers that “IKEA's departure doesn't mean you have to give up your familiar interior design style,” adding that they “now have the opportunity to buy those same beloved products.”

“Yes, their appearance and names have changed slightly,” the blurb on the website said. “But the design, quality, ease of purchase, and ease of assembly remain unchanged.”

IKEA said it could not comment on individual cases, but noted that it “continuously monitors potential infringements” on its intellectual property rights.

title: An Arizona County’s “Housing Hub” Is a Dead End for Many Homeless Families
content:
A decade ago, nonprofit leaders in Arizona’s most populous county boasted that they had created the Amazon of homeless service systems. Families in crisis would no longer have to contact a dozen agencies in search of shelter or housing. A single system could point them to help.

But for all the hype, this system has become a dead end for many families. A 2023 evaluation found 94% of people who were assessed for housing help by the system didn’t receive it. And that didn’t account for parents who were unable to connect with a worker to see if they qualified for assistance.

Families say it hasn’t improved.

In interviews, 30 families that are homeless told ProPublica that calling the hotline, meeting with outreach workers or showing up at shelters rarely results in offers of help. Some families said they called 211 multiple times without being connected to the homeless response system for families, known as the Family Housing Hub. Others, who said they were sleeping in cars or outdoors, said they couldn’t get a spot on the waitlist for shelter.

title: Valmetin muutosneuvottelut päättyivät – Suomessa vähennetään 120 työtehtävää
content:
Valmet vähentää muutosneuvottelujen päätteeksi noin 120 työtehtävää Suomessa.

Yhtiö kertoo verkkosivuillaan, että vähennykset ovat osa toimia, joilla yhtiö pyrkii edelleen parantamaan tehokkuuttaan ja kilpailukykyään. Henkilöstövähennysten lisäksi tulossa on tehtävien ja vastuiden uudelleenjärjestelyjä.

Muutosneuvottelut aloitettiin elokuussa. Tavoitteena oli erityisesti Biomateriaaliratkaisut ja -palvelut -segmentin kilpailukyvyn parantaminen.

Yhtiö kertoi heinäkuussa aloittavansa strategisen arvioinnin kahden ydinliiketoimintansa, eli biomateriaaliratkaisujen ja prosessitehokkuusratkaisujen mahdollisesta eriyttämisestä kahdeksi itsenäiseksi pörssiyhtiöksi. Aiemmin tällä viikolla päättyneet muutosneuvottelut eivät Valmetin mukaan liity tähän arviointiin.

Valmetilla on maailmanlaajuisesti noin 18 500 työntekijää, joista noin 5 600 työskentelee Suomessa.

title: OutoValo kutsuu nauttimaan valosta pimeydessä monin eri tavoin
content:
Outokummun kaupungin OutoValo-festivaali 22.–24.10.2026 tuo jälleen valon, taiteen ja yhteisöllisyyden keskelle syksyn pimeintä aikaa.

Kolmipäiväinen tapahtuma muuttaa kaupungin keskustan ja vanhan kaivosympäristön elämykselliseksi kokonaisuudeksi, jossa valotaide, musiikki, kulttuuriperintö ja iloiset ihmiset kohtaavat toisensa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa koko perheelle maksuttomia kulttuurielämyksiä ja nostaa esiin paikallisen ympäristön ainutlaatuisia piirteitä uudessa valossa.

Tänä vuonna tapahtumassa on huomioitu myös heidät, jotka eivät näkörajoitteiden vuoksi voi nauttia perinteisestä valotaiteesta. Yhtenä spesiaaliohjelmana on nimittäin sekä torstaina, että perjantaina esitettävä Toven rakkaus ja Freskot kirjeiden valossa. Kuvailutulkkaukseen pohjautuva esitys rakentuu rakastetun kuvataiteilijan ja kirjailijan, Tove Janssonin kirjeiden ympärille. Teatterilla on tämänvuotisessa ohjelmassa muutenkin vahva osuus, sillä perjantaina nähdään myös Pöhinäpaku-työryhmän esitys Tyhjän tankin teatteri, ja lauantaina Kaivosteatterin kantaesitysensi-ilta näytelmästä Tunneli.

title: End Of Abyss review – a creepy dollhouse take on Resident Evil and The Thing
content:
PlayStation 5 (version played), Xbox, PC; Epic Games Publishing
This fetchingly presented horror game brings style and scares, but overextends itself with repetition

A small band of soldiers enters an abandoned facility, where puckered flesh sprouts from cold steel. It’s a promising but familiar start to a sci-fi horror story, with heavy overtones of Alien and The Thing. Neither of those, though, were so … dinky.

End of Abyss’s facility is presented as a kind of a model-village recreation of The Thing’s Outpost 31 that you peer into from above. Your little bobble-headed hero takes up a tiny fraction of the screen, with most of the remainder drenched in foggy darkness, or even blanked out entirely. This is a world of Usborne-style cutaways, where anything outside the walls is total blackness.

title: “My activism dates back to when I was 11”: Julie, a survivor and human rights champion
content:
This blog contains descriptions of sexual abuse. We included this to stay true to survivors’ testimonies and their word.

Julie Gbanmeton, 26, is about to defend her master’s thesis in law at Parakou university, in northern Benin. Named a Human Rights Star by Amnesty International Benin in 2024, she leads her own organization – Femmes guerrières d’Afrique pour le développement (African Women Warriors for Development). With more than 50 members throughout Benin and Togo, its members conduct community outreach to promote women’s leadership and human rights.

“My activism dates back to when I was 11 years old because I experienced violence at that age. I was raped. And the first thing I did was speak out.

One weekend, I was left in the care of a man my parents knew. My father had something to do, so he asked the man to stay with me. Night fell, I went to bed to sleep, and while I was asleep, he committed his crime.

title: Prisoner Executed at Adelabad Prison in Shiraz
content:
According to HRANA, a prisoner was executed at Adelabad Prison in Shiraz.

HRANA has confirmed the identity of the prisoner, who was hanged at dawn yesterday, Thursday, October 8, as Mehdi Alizadeh.

According to the report, Mr. Alizadeh had previously been arrested on non-political charges and subsequently sentenced to death by judicial authorities.

As of the time of this report, the execution has not been officially announced by prison authorities or other relevant institutions.

According to HRA’s Annual Report, in 2025 at least 2,063 citizens, including 61 women and 2 juvenile offenders, were executed. Of these, the sentences of 11 individuals were carried out in public. During the same period, 172 other individuals were sentenced to death.

title: We’re Investigating Prior Authorization. Help ProPublica Understand Your Health Insurance Denial.
content:
Last year, many of America’s largest health insurers vowed to reduce their use of prior authorization — the extra layer of approval insurers require before covering a medical expense. The industry’s pledge came after massive backlash to the process from patients, providers and politicians. ProPublica’s reporting has found it can delay or outright deny patients’ critical medical care.

Data as of last year shows the industry is still relying heavily on the approval process. Now, ProPublica is looking into the ways that insurers’ continued use of prior authorization is impacting patients. We need your help to figure out if prior authorization is still leading to delayed or missed treatments, tests, medical equipment or medication.

If you are covered by a plan through Medicaid, Medicare, Children’s Health Insurance Program, or the Affordable Care Act marketplace — and have had a prior authorization request delayed or denied — we want to hear from you. Your experiences help us better understand the real-life stakes of prior authorization. (For this investigation, we’re not seeking responses from people with insurance through their employer at this time.)

title: 'It Is Done. Hail Satan:' City Immediately Regrets New Religious Liberty Law That Allows Prayer at City Council Meeting
content:
An Iowa man has kicked off controversy over religious freedom in the small town of Ottumwa, Iowa by opening a city council meeting with a prayer to Satan, which then kicked off a debate about the proper time in the meeting agenda to undo the “curse.” 

On Tuesday night, Ottumwa resident, satanist, and former city council member Matt Dalbey took the podium to read an invocation to start a routine meeting of the council. “Thank you mayor, council. Let us pray,” Dalbey started. “Dear dark father, let us stand now unbowed and unfettered by arcane doctrines born of fearful minds and darkened times. Let us embrace the Luciferan impulse to eat off the tree of knowledge and dissipate our blissful and comforting delusions of old.”

title: Afghanistan, 25 Years Later: Journalist Emran Feroz on the Legacy of "America's Longest War"
content:
This week marks 25 years since the U.S.-led invasion of Afghanistan, the beginning of what would become the longest war in U.S. history. After installing a pro-Western government in Kabul in December 2001, U.S. and other NATO troops would remain in the country for the next two decades battling a stubborn insurgency — until a chaotic U.S. withdrawal in August 2021 that saw the Taliban return to power.

“During the 20 years of America’s longest war in Afghanistan, we could clearly see that failure was coming,” says journalist Emran Feroz, just back from a month of reporting in Afghanistan. He says the relative economic and political gains under the Western-backed government were undercut by widespread corruption and violence, particularly in rural Afghanistan. “You had torture prisons next to Burger King and KFC and Starbucks.”

title: Nyt tuli tyrmäys kohuehdotukselle: ”Se ei käy tässä salissa varmaan yhdellekään eduskuntapuolueelle”
content:
Pääministeri Petteri Orpo (kok.) tyrmää eläkeiän noston.

- Voin omana mielipiteenäni todeta sen, että 70 vuotta on täysin epärealistinen. Se ei luultavasti käy. Se ei käy tässä salissa varmaan yhdellekään eduskuntapuolueelle, hän sanoi kyselytunnilla eduskunnassa torstaina.

Valtiovarainministeriö ehdotti virkapuheenvuorossaan alimman vanhuuseläkeiän nostamista 70 vuoteen. Keskiviikkona julkistettu puheenvuoro sisälsi useita eri toimenpide-ehdotuksia tulevalle hallitukselle.

Orpo muistutti, että jo tällä hetkellä eläkeikä nousee, koska se on sidottu elinikäodotteeseen.

- Pitää voida tarkastella, onko järkeä nopeampaan tahtiin nostaa, Orpo sanoi.

Kokoomus itse esitti viime viikolla, että eläkejärjestelmää uudistamalla pitäisi tehdä ensi vaalikaudella kahden miljardin euron säästöt. Orpo toisti kyselytunnilla puolueen tavoitteen eli että suomalaisten työuria tulee pidentää ”alusta, keskeltä ja lopusta”.

Orpo sanoi kyselytunnilla myös, että kokoomus ei tavoittele maksuun menevien tai maksussa olevien eläkkeiden leikkaamista.

title: Two Roles, One Wikimedia Education Ecosystem: Lessons from WikiConference North America 2026
content:
What happens when different approaches to Wikimedia education connect? At WikiConference North America 2026, we explored how classroom-based learning and global community support can strengthen the same movement.

What is the difference between Wiki Education and EduWiki Hub? And why do we need both?

These were the questions LiAnna Davis of Wiki Education and I explored during our session, “Decoding Wiki Education & EduWiki: Two Roles. One Wikimedia Education Ecosystem,” at WikiConference North America 2026 on 26 September. More than 20 participants joined us for the discussion.

As EduWiki Hub Coordinator, I wanted to help clarify not just what distinguishes the two organisations, but also how their work connects to the wider Wikimedia education movement.

Wikimedia education takes many forms. It can involve university students improving Wikipedia articles, teachers integrating Wikimedia into their courses, volunteers documenting local knowledge, or communities organising educational programmes in their regions.

These activities share a commitment to learning and open knowledge, but they do not all require the same kind of support.

title: When No ID Means No Internet: Age Verification and the Right to Access Information
content:
This post was co-authored by Sheila B. Lalwani, a doctorate student and recent COMPASS Fellow hosted by EFF.

Age verification proposals are often presented as a simple tradeoff: sacrifice a little privacy to better safeguard children online. But that framing overlooks a more fundamental question. What happens to people who cannot verify their age at all? This is particularly a problem when users are required to prove their age with identity documents.

Age-related restrictions are developing quickly around the world. While they differ radically across jurisdictions, in the past year, we’ve witnessed a sharp uptick toward mandatory age assurance for social media access but also for other high-risk digital services.

For example:

  • In late 2025, Australia became the first country to implement a minimum age requirement for prohibiting children under age 16 from creating or holding social media accounts. 
  • India passed the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act that includes mandatory verifiable parental consent and has undertaken ongoing discussions for social media restriction.

title: A post-war gem worth fighting for: Kortrijk Railway Station, Belgium
content:
Rebuilt in 1951 to a design by architect Pierre Albert Pauwels, Kortrijk Railway Station in Western Belgium is a landmark of post-war architecture in the Expo 58 style, blending neoclassical and contemporary elements. Since 2015, when the station’s owner unveiled their plans for a new station, the building has been under threat of demolition, which would mean the loss not only of an architectural gem but also of a much-used public space. Kortrijk Railway Station was listed among the 7 Most Endangered heritage sites in Europe for 2023 by Europa Nostra.

Since its involvement in the 7 Most Endangered Programme, the station has gained international attention and a stronger voice in the debate over its future. The Flemish Association for Industrial Archaeology (VVIA), which nominated the site to the programme with the endorsement of Europa Nostra Belgium, has campaigned against demolition and for the building’s sustainable reuse, with the ambition of showing that post-war railway heritage can be conserved and given new life as a public space.

Europa Nostra spoke with Hendrik Nelde, President of VVIA, who has led the campaign to save the station, to hear about its inspiring journey.

title: A Strong Mandate Amid Falling Participation
content:
On 3 October, Latvians elected a new parliament. Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs’ regionalist, green and conservative United List (Latvian: Apvienotais saraksts, AS) more than doubled its seats, from 15 to 41. The answer to the question, however, whether the country ‘woke up to a new reality’ after these elections is both no and yes.

No, because our government will apparently be almost the same as it was before the election. Yes, because, for the first time in many years, one party has secured such a substantial lead that it can form a coalition with virtually any other political force elected to the 15th Saeima, the Latvian parliament, except the liberal-conservative ‘New Unity’ alliance. A three-party coalition would now be needed for building a broad and balanced coalition government.

content:

Vanha ääniteilmoitus on käytettävissä sunnuntaihin 18.10.2026 asti. Maanantaina 19.10.2026 palvelussa on käyttökatko uuden ääniteilmoituksen käyttöönoton vuoksi. Uudistettu ääniteilmoitus sisältää useita uusia ominaisuuksia, jotka helpottavat ilmoitusten tekemistä:

Ääniteilmoitus tallentuu käyttäjän edetessä, joten sen täyttämistä voi jatkaa myöhemmin. Tämä tekee erityisesti laajempien ääniteilmoitusten tekemisestä sujuvampaa.

Yhteistuotannot ja prosenttiosuudet voidaan jatkossa ilmoittaa suoraan ääniteilmoituksen tekovaiheessa.

Uusi käyttöliittymä on aiempaa modernimpi, intuitiivisempi ja helpompi käyttää. Tavoitteena on tehdä ilmoituksen täyttämisestä mahdollisimman sujuvaa kaikille käyttäjille.

  • 19.10.2026: käyttökatko uuden palvelun käyttöönoton vuoksi

title: Airstrike Damages Hospital in Central Ukraine
content:
A Russian airstrike damaged a hospital in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih on October 6, according to reports from local officials and media outlets. The attack injured several people, including at least two hospital workers, and also damaged residential and administrative buildings and an art school in the city center.  

The strike is the latest in a long string of Russian attacks in Ukraine that impact health care workers and facilities and seriously threaten the right to health. In some cases, these attacks may constitute war crimes.

The World Health Organization (WHO) has recorded more than 3,300 attacks impacting health care since the full scale February 2022 invasion, resulting in the deaths of 248 health workers with 1,095 injured. In September, a Russian strike damaged a maternity hospital in Kyiv and killed one person in its car park. It was one of a series of drone and missile attacks across Ukraine that day that killed eight people, most of them in Kharkiv and two in Kyiv and the Kyiv region, Ukrainian authorities said.

content:

Sosiaaliturvan heikennykset ovat lisänneet toimeentulovaikeuksia ja syventäneet köyhyyttä. Suomessa yhä useampi ihminen kamppailee arjessaan toimeentulon kanssa. Monille köyhyys on jokapäiväistä todellisuutta: rahat eivät riitä ruokaan, lääkkeisiin tai muihin välttämättömiin menoihin.

Sosiaaliturvaleikkaukset ovat kohdistuneet erityisesti jo ennestään vaikeassa asemassa oleviin ihmisryhmiin, kuten pitkäaikaissairaisiin, työkyvyttömiin ja pitkään toimeentulotuen varassa eläviin ihmisiin.

title: Expert tips: When your digital footprint becomes a vulnerability
content:
For journalists, the attack may begin long before the first threatening message arrives. A phone number buried in an old student website, an abandoned social media account, a photograph revealing parts of your home in the background, or information about a family member can all become pieces of a much larger picture.

That was the starting point for a workshop on identifying digital vulnerabilities and understanding the online attacks that can target journalists, held during IJ4EU’s recent UNCOVERED Conference.

The aim was not to offer a single security checklist or a silver bullet. (Spoiler alert: there’s not such a thing against these attacks.) Instead, the session explored how journalists can develop the analytical skills to understand their own exposure — and recognise when apparently random online abuse is actually part of a coordinated campaign.

Titled Defending the Beat when the Backlash Comes Online, the workshop was led by Javier Luque, head of digital media and online safety at the International Press Institute.

title: Internet Archive to Demo Wayback Machine at Friday’s Uniqlo Street Festival
content:
The Internet Archive is joining other area nonprofits for the Uniqlo Street Festival on Friday, October 9, 2026, alongside the opening of Uniqlo’s new flagship store on Market Street. We’ll be set up with fellow San Francisco nonprofits Gray Area and the Exploratorium to help bring people and energy back to a part of the city that has sorely missed shoppers and foot traffic. We’ll be demoing the Wayback Machine, handing out stickers, and talking with attendees about digital preservation.

“Libraries have always found interesting ways to get in front of new audiences. More people than ever need to know about the valuable service of the Wayback Machine and why our digital culture should be preserved. People may be aware of the Internet Archive, but may not realize that we are also a San Francisco organization. This gives us an opportunity to meet with people in our community during this event,” said Merrilee Proffitt, director of Democracy’s Library US at the Internet Archive, who will be at the booth on Friday. “Plus, to be honest, I think many of us have a Uniqlo hoodie or two in our closets.”

title: Lukemaan innostaminen on yhteinen asia
content:
”Se, että siinä ollaan hyvän puolella. On hienoa olla edistämässä alaa, jonka tulokset ovat aina positiivisia.”

”Kirjasto on suomalaisen sivistyksen kulmakivi. Olen ylpeä siitä, että ennen Suomessa oli kirkko keskellä kylää – nyt siellä on myös kirjasto keskellä kylää. Toivottavasti se kokoaa ihmiset yhteen kirjojen äärelle. Mikäs sen parempaa.”

”Suomen Kustannusyhdistyksellä on ikään kuin kaksi puolta. Toinen on se, että se edistää kaupallisen kustantamisen edellytyksiä, ja toinen on aatteellinen puoli. Eli me olemme lukemista edistävä järjestö.”

”Kampanja kohdistuu erityisesti koululaisiin, koska se järjestetään koululaisten syysloman aikaan. Se on lukemiseen innostava kampanja, jossa avataan ovia niihin lukemattomiin maailmoihin, joita kirjat tarjoavat. Siihen voivat osallistua luokat, yksilöt, vanhemmat ja isovanhemmat, yhdessä tai erikseen, ja jakaa kokemuksia lukemisesta muiden kanssa.”

”Luokista ja opettajilta tulee spontaania palautetta, että tämä on ollut hyvä ja onnistunut. Tietysti pitkällä aikavälillä myös se, että lukemisen taso tässä maassa nousee, mutta se ei ole pelkästään Lukuloma-kampanjan tehtävä.”

title: 3 November Deadline - Shape EU Copyright Reform: Your KR21 Guide to the Targeted Consultation | Knowledge Rights 21
content:
View this email in your browser

Copyright reform is back on the European agenda. On 29 September, the European Commission (EC) launched a targeted consultation on the effect of technology on copyright (deadline: 3 November). Two of the areas it covers go to the heart of the knowledge community’s work: the use of copyright-protected content in AI, and copyright in scientific research.

The consultation is broader than these two areas, but they matter most to the knowledge community, and our guide focuses on them. It will be important to maximise the number of voices from the library and research sector. To help, we are happy to share an informal answering guide.

You should of course respond in line with your own views and experiences. But we hope the guide gives you an idea of where to focus your efforts, and which answers align best with KR21’s wider work to ensure the EU’s rules work for research, education and cultural participation.

One thing to watch for: a law can look right on paper and still fail in practice. The culprits are poison pills, provisions that quietly drain a law of its effect. Read our analysis and make sure they are called out in your response.

title: Lausunto: KULTA ry kannattaa lahjoitusvähennyksen laajentamista
content:
Hallituksen esitys eduskunnalle laeiksi vuoden 2027 tuloveroasteikosta ja tuloverolain muuttamisesta sekä eräiksi muiksi verolaeiksi (HE 174/2026 vp).

Kulttuuri- ja taidealan keskusjärjestö KULTA ry kiittää mahdollisuudesta lausua hallituksen esityksestä.

KULTA pitää erittäin kannatettavana ja tervetulleena esitykseen sisältyvää lahjoitusvähennyksen laajentamista kulttuuri-, nuoriso-, liikunta- ja urheilujärjestöille sekä sosiaali- ja terveysalan järjestöille. Tämä on pitkään ajettu uudistus, joka edistää kansalaisyhteiskunnan toimintaedellytyksiä ja monipuolistaa kulttuurisektorin rahoituspohjaa. KULTA korostaa kuitenkin, että lahjoitusvähennyksen laajentaminen ja yksityisen rahoituksen kannustaminen eivät saa korvata tai leikata julkista kulttuurirahoitusta. Yksityinen lahjoitustoiminta toimii parhaiten julkisen rahoituksen täydentäjänä, ei sen korvaajana.

Esityksen mukaan yhteisöjen ja luonnollisten henkilöiden vähennyskelpoisten lahjoitusten saajajoukkoa yhtenäistetään ja laajennetaan muun muassa kulttuuria edistäviin järjestöihin.

title: Korvauksia maksettiin kesän vuositilityksessä aiempaa useammalle – taiteilijoiden korvauskäytänteitä tulee silti kehittää
content:
Kuvasto maksoi kesä-syyskuun vuositilityksessä noin 791 000 euroa tekijänoikeuskorvauksia yhteensä 2 400 taiteilijalle ja oikeudenhaltijalle. Tilityskynnyksen laskeminen 30 euroon kasvatti korvauksensaajien määrää edellisvuodesta.

Taiteilijoille kertyy tekijänoikeuskorvauksia sen mukaan, miten paljon ja missä yhteydessä heidän taideteoksiaan hyödynnetään. Kuvasto kerää ja tilittää kuvataiteen tekijänoikeuskorvauksia pääasiassa Kuvastoon liittyneille taiteilijoille, mutta myös muille taiteilijoille.

Kesäkuun alussa käynnistynyt korvausten vuositilitys päättyi 30. syyskuuta. Sen aikana taiteilijoille ja edesmenneiden taiteilijoiden oikeudenhaltijoille maksettiin korvauksia yhteensä 791 000 euroa.

Osa vuoden aikana maksettavista korvauksista tilitetään nopeutetusti taiteilijoiden pyynnöstä. Kaikkiaan olemme maksaneet korvauksia vuoden alusta alkaen noin 823 000 euroa, kun huomioon otetaan myös nopeutetussa menettelyssä maksetut korvaukset.
