title: Meksikolaisessa vankilateatterissa roolia esittää myös katsoja
content:
Jonotan pääsisäänkäynnin edessä Neza-Bordon vankilassa, joka sijaitsee pääkaupunki Méxicon ulkopuolella. Olen pukeutunut ohjeen mukaan sinisiin farkkuihin, valkoiseen paitaan ja lenkkareihin, kuten kaikki muutkin vankilateatteria katsomaan tulevat.

Ohitamme toisen jonon, jossa seisovat ovat pukeutuneet kirkkaanpunaisiin tai vaaleanpunaisiin vaatteisiin. He ovat vankien omaisia, jotka raahaavat suuria läpinäkyviä kasseja. Niissä on leipää, vesikanistereita ja vaatteita.

Teatteriretken on järjestänyt paikallinen kansalaisjärjestö. Bussimatkan aikana sen työntekijät ovat kertoneet, mikä meitä perillä odottaa.

Olemme saaneet kuulla, että Neza-Bordo on korkean turvallisuusluokituksen vankila, jossa on yhteensä noin 6 000 vankia, sekä naisia että miehiä. Monet heistä on tuomittu kidnappauksista tai murhista.

”Tuomituilla on beiget vaatteet, tutkintavankeudessa olevilla tummansiniset”, he ovat selittäneet.

Kansalaisjärjestö tekee töitä erityisesti naisvankien kanssa. Teatterin ohella naisille järjestetään työpajoja ja koulutuksia. Kun vangit vapautuvat, järjestön työntekijät menevät naisia vankilan portille vastaan.

title: Canada’s bill C-22 threatens encryption, users’ privacy and the security of digital economies
content: Encryption is woven into everyday digital life. It protects our messages and passwords, but also banking and payments, health data, government services and the digital infrastructure societies rely on every day. Yet across jurisdictions, governments are increasingly considering laws that expand lawful access to data for law enforcement and national security purposes. In practice, this can mean requiring companies to create new ways to access encrypted data, introduce technical capabilities that bypass existing protections, or make otherwise secure systems insecure. These measures can weaken the very security encryption is designed to provide, with consequences for cybersecurity, privacy, fundamental rights and the wider economy. Canada’s Bill C-22 is the latest example of this trend, raising serious concerns about the security and privacy consequences of expanding government access to data.

title: Kansainväliset huippututkijat saapuivat vierailulle Museoliittoon
content:
Museoalan kansainväliset vaikuttajat University College Londonin perinnöntutkimuksen professori Rodney Harrison sekä Stavangerin yliopiston historian professori ja ympäristöhumanistiseen tutkimukseen keskittyvän Greenhouse Center for Environmental Humanities -keskuksen toinen johtaja Dolly Jørgensen vierailivat Suomen museoliitolla torstaina 8.10.2026 osana Heritage Futures in Museums & Society -iltapäiväseminaaria.

Suomeen Harrisonin ja Jørgensenin tuo PITCH-hanke, jonka tavoitteena on tuoda näkyväksi kulttuuriperinnön kytköksiä petrokulttuuriin sekä tarjota päättäjille välineitä toteuttaa oikeudenmukainen vihreä siirtymä perintöajattelun keinoin. Projektissa on mukana Suomen Metsämuseo Lusto, jonka kehittämisjohtaja Leena Paaskoski on työstänyt Harrisonin kanssa kestävyystieteiden ydinsanastoa aikaisemminkin.

title: Does Claude Feel The Whip?
content:
Someone recently built a digital whip to make Claude work faster. The tool, aptly named BadClaude, sits in your system tray and lets you drag an animated whip across the AI’s window; each crack, sound effect and all, interrupts the model mid-response and snaps a command at it to speed things up. It even addresses Claude as “clanker,” the internet’s freshly minted slur for robots.

The demo video racked up millions of views in a couple of days; a cease-and-desist letter from Anthropic went viral before anyone noticed it was fake. And a day later, someone shipped the antidote: a rival tool called GoodClaude that praises the model and cheers it along while it works. One scolds, the other encourages. The original developer, posting under the handle @blended_jpeg, is in on the joke. His public roadmap promises a feature that keeps a running tally of how many times you have whipped your Claude — a ledger of abuse — so robots know where to take revenge when they’re ready.

title: Nearly 50 Arrested as Police Target Western Balkan Drug Network
content:
Nearly 50 suspects have been detained following an international crackdown on a Western Balkan drug syndicate allegedly linked to murders, kidnappings, and grenade attacks across Europe, Europol announced on Thursday.

The multi-year investigation culminated on October 6, when police searched 42 properties across Slovenia and Spain. Law enforcement arrested 36 suspects on the action day—34 in Slovenia, one in Spain, and one in Croatia—adding to 11 members previously detained during the probe.

The syndicate comprised nationals from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Türkiye, and the Netherlands. To move cocaine, cannabis, amphetamine, MDMA, and methamphetamine from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Spain to destinations across Europe, the group allegedly hired drivers—chiefly from Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Bulgaria—to conceal illicit cargo within regular commercial shipments using trucks, vans, and cars.

title: The Strange and Brilliant Inventions of Nikola Tesla
content: Even before the success of the electric car company that now bears his name, Nikola Tesla was a widely respected historical figure. Often, that respect could be based on surprisingly scant knowledge of the man’s life and accomplishments. Didn’t he do something with electricity? Wasn’t he involved in some kind of rivalry with Thomas Edison? Wouldn’t we all be enjoying wirelessly transmitted power, too cheap to meter, if his noble, solitary efforts hadn’t been thwarted by the establishment? Well, perhaps. Whatever dramatic satisfactions we find in Tesla’s story, we can only gauge his genius by surveying his actual inventions, four of which are explained in the new Lost in Time video above.

title: Open Enables a Lot: The OSI at UNGA81
content:
On Monday, September 21, with the high-level week of the 81st UN General Assembly (UNGA81) underway in New York, OSI Executive Director Duane O’Brien spoke on a UN panel about Open Source AI and joined a Creative Commons symposium on openness and digital sovereignty. The OSI also attended the inaugural 50-in-5 Awards for digital public infrastructure. Different people filled each room, but many of them were circling the same question: what does openness give people, and what does it take to make good on it?

At the Creative Commons event, Duane offered a ten-word answer: “Open by itself does very little but enables a lot.” Creative Commons later called it the line of the day. Most of what the OSI said at UNGA81 was about the distance between the two halves of that sentence.

At UN Digital Cooperation Day, organized by the UN Office for Digital and Emerging Technologies (ODET), Duane joined the panel “What is Open Source AI? Applications, Strategies and Global Cooperation.” Sarah Myers West of the AI Now Institute moderated a conversation with Duane, Kari Briski of NVIDIA, Marzieh Fadaee of Cohere Labs, Jim Zemlin of the Linux Foundation, and Rumman Chowdhury of Humane Intelligence.

title: U.S. Lawmakers Launch Sexual Abuse Probe of Youth Sports Giant AAU
content:
What Happened: Bipartisan leaders from the powerful House Energy and Commerce Committee launched an inquiry on Wednesday into the Amateur Athletic Union, criticizing the sprawling youth sports organization for its handling of child sexual abuse allegations and demanding answers, citing reporting by ProPublica and The Washington Post.

What They Said: “It is unacceptable that AAU is failing to implement standard reforms to protect child athletes, and is misleading the public, parents, and athletes about preventative measures in place within AAU sports,” the letter reads.

The committee chair, Kentucky Republican Brett Guthrie, called ProPublica and The Post’s reporting “deeply disturbing” in a statement on Thursday, saying it “raises serious questions about the organization’s actions over the past decade.” 

“Our Committee is seeking information on how the AAU’s policies have potentially fallen short, and what needs to be done in order to protect young athletes,” Guthrie said.”

title: Kirjastot näkyviin tulevissa eduskuntavaaleissa!
content:
Ensi kevään eduskuntavaalit ovat erinomainen tilaisuus näyttää, miten tärkeitä kirjastot ovat suomalaisille. Haluamme tuoda kirjastot näyttävästi esiin ja toivomme, että mahdollisimman moni kirjasto osallistuu Kirjaston puolustajat -kampanjaan.

Julkaisemme tammikuussa kampanjasivuston, johon pyydämme eduskuntavaalien ehdokkaita kertomaan näkemyksiään kirjastosta. Sivustolta ehdokkaat näkevät myös kirjastojen  järjestämät tapahtumat ja voivat ilmoittaa osallistumisestaan niihin. Toivomme, että niin kirjastot kuin ehdokkaatkin jakavat sivustoa omissa kanavissaan, jotta mahdollisimman moni äänestäjä löytää nämä arvokkaat kirjastosisällöt.

Kirjaston puolustajat -kampanja huipentuu valtakunnallisena Kirjaston päivänä 19.3.2027 ja kannustammekin kaikkia kirjastoja järjestämään tuolloin tapahtuman omassa kirjastossaan.

Tapahtuma voi olla esimerkisi:

  • Kirjaston ja toiminnan esittely eduskuntavaaliehdokkaille.
  • Keskustelutilaisuus, jossa on paikalla ehdokkaita useammasta puolueesta sekä kirjaston asiakkaita.
  • Valtakunnallisen keskustelutapahtuman striimaus Kirjaston päivänä 19.3. Tapahtuma järjestetään yhteistyössä Kirjastokaistan kanssa.

title: Blogi: Kun taiteilijan maailma muuttuu, miten järjestön pitäisi muuttua?
content:
Kuvataiteilijan toimintaympäristö on muuttunut nopeasti. Toimeentulo muodostuu yhä useammista lähteistä, julkinen rahoitus on paineessa, kansainvälisyyden ja liikkuvuuden ehdot muuttuvat, teknologia ja tekoäly vaikuttavat taiteelliseen työhön ja uusia ansaintamalleja etsitään. Samalla taiteilijuuden suhteet muihin yhteiskunnan sektoreihin ovat liikkeessä. 

Kun taiteilijan maailma muuttuu, myös häntä edustavien järjestöjen on tarkasteltava omaa tehtäväänsä. 

Suomalaisilla järjestöillä on pitkä historia yhteiskunnan rakentajina. Ihmiset ovat järjestäytyneet, koska he ovat havainneet ympärillään epäkohtia, tarpeita ja mahdollisuuksia, joihin yhdessä toimimalla voidaan vaikuttaa. 

Sama perusajatus pätee taiteilijajärjestöihin. Järjestäytyminen kokoaa yksittäisten taiteilijoiden tarpeita yhteiseksi ääneksi, toiminnaksi ja neuvotteluvoimaksi. Sen avulla voidaan vaikuttaa esimerkiksi taiteilijoiden toimeentuloon, ammatilliseen asemaan, rahoitukseen, näyttelytoiminnan edellytyksiin ja taiteen asemaan yhteiskunnassa. 

Tästä näkökulmasta järjestön rakenteet ovat välineitä perustehtävän toteuttamiseen.

title: EU cyber and science researchers are testing Chinese AI models
content:
BRUSSELS — The European Union’s cybersecurity agency and in-house research center have each begun experimenting with open artificial intelligence models from China, three EU officials have told POLITICO.

The Joint Research Centre (JRC) — the EU’s in-house scientific research center — is evaluating “publicly available open-weight models” originating from China, European Commission spokesperson Maciej Berestecki confirmed. The head of ENISA, the bloc’s agency responsible for cybersecurity, also said in an interview that his team was now testing Chinese AI.

The experiments with Chinese models at the JRC are part of a broader research project to evaluate artificial intelligence that also includes leading models from the United States and Europe, Berestecki said. “Models from different origins are included in a comparative scientific evaluation of their capabilities, performance, limitations and risks,” he said, adding that the JRC is also looking into their potential scientific applications.

title: Nobel laureate Karl Deisseroth on how light is changing what we know about the brain
content:
When Karl Deisseroth was studying to be a doctor in the 1990s, he took a rotation working with psychiatric patients. It would start him down a path of discovery about how the brain works that would eventually lead him to become a Nobel laureate.

The brain is billions of fragile, extremely vulnerable, transparent, very fast-acting cells. It’s a very challenging system to study, and of course, buried within the skull and doing very complex things … I was very much impressed with the magnitude of the challenge.

title: Informing AI Strategy and Literacy: An Interview with Sylvia Staal Riordan
content:
In this interview, 2026 Library of Congress intern Sylvia Staal Riordan reflects on her experience working in the Digital Strategy Directorate of the Library’s Office of the Chief Information Officer. This interview has been edited for length and clarity.

Leah: Hi Sylvia! It’s great to have you on our team this summer. Could you tell us about your role at the Library, and what you’ve worked on?

Sylvia: My role at the Library this summer was Artificial Intelligence Community Specialist Intern, which involved working with the Digital Strategy Directorate on various AI literacy, strategy, and community engagement initiatives.

One of the main AI literacy projects I completed was taking the Library’s Principles for Responsible AI Use and mapping them to actionable AI-related competencies. I shared this in a chart format that was easily readable and accessible for Library staff members regardless of their familiarity with AI, hopefully to help empower them to make informed judgements about the technology. I also conducted a survey with my fellow interns to gauge their feelings about AI to help inform the direction of AI literacy at the Library, and was involved with AI strategy development.

content:
Urban research is stronger than ever at the University of Helsinki and in the capital region. The strategic partnership between the university and the City of Helsinki was highlighted by strong attendance from both organizations, and several presentations and discussions focusing on Helsinki and the diverse collaboration between the university and the city.

Urbaria continues playing a significant role in this collaboration, especially as a facilitator of research-based decision-making in the capital region. Thanks to its international scientific network, Urbaria is able to connect Finnish cities with international researchers and other municipal actors as well.

The event was a great example of the power of collaboration. We are thankful to for creating the original concept of UniverCities conference. The annual conference has developed, and will continue to develop, the international networks of the urban researchers of the University of Helsinki. In addition, it offers researchers a valuable opportunity to take part in current international discussions on urban research and development.

content:
Vihreiden Mari Holopainen vaatii hallitusta perumaan esityksen, joka poistaisi pankkien ja pankkiiriliikkeiden sisäpiirirekisterien julkisuuden. Valtiovarainministeriön valmistelema laki piilottaisi pankkiiriliikkeiden pörssikaupat.

Kansanedustaja Holopainen arvostelee tästä etenkin perussuomalaisia.

title: In Wikimedia-Projekten wurden Aktivitäten von „abtrünnigen“ OpenAI-Agenten festgestellt
content:
Hinweis: Dieser Artikel ist eine deutsche Übersetzung der Original-Meldung der Wikimedia Foundation.

Selena Deckelmann ist Chief Product and Technology Officer der Wikimedia Foundation. In dieser Funktion leitet sie die Produkt- und Technologieteams und ist somit für die technische Infrastruktur und die Weiterentwicklung der Wikimedia-Projekte verantwortlich. Zuvor war sie als Senior Vice President bei Mozilla tätig, wo sie für Firefox verantwortlich war.

Vor kurzem haben mehrere Organisationen bekannt gegeben, wie Gruppen sogenannter „ausgebrochener“ KI-Agenten versucht haben, in Websites und Online-Dienste einzudringen – teilweise sogar erfolgreich. Insbesondere ist bekannt, dass Agenten aus dem Umfeld von OpenAI andere öffentliche Wikis (gemeinsam bearbeitete Websites, die nicht uns gehören) genutzt haben, um miteinander zu kommunizieren und sich abzustimmen.

title: Mapping the European Rights Retention Community of Practice: Mobilising Change
content:
Blog post by Clara Riera

Rights retention is gaining momentum across Europe. To make this progress more visible, we mapped where members of the European Rights Retention Community of Practice are based and where interest in it is growing.

Since KR21 project partner SPARC Europe launched this community in late 2024, it has grown to almost 725 members worldwide, with over 665 from 31 European countries. Its 11th meeting on 8 October 2026 marked almost two years of regular exchange among researchers, librarians, policy professionals and others working to advance rights retention. 

This new map is a simple way to visualise this growing community. It shows where members are joining from, highlighting the spread of interest across Europe and, more broadly, the community’s international reach. The map reflects one of the community’s main aims: supporting the development of rights retention in institutional policymaking as a route to achieving 100% open access in Europe.

title: "The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist": Daniel Roher, Tristan Harris Discuss New Film
content:
As the development of artificial intelligence accelerates, more voices inside and outside the industry are warning that the technology poses major risks to humanity. The new film, The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist, features interviews with leading AI executives, researchers, as well as critics, who all voice similar concerns. Since the film’s release earlier this year, a number of AI-driven hacks and other incidents have further alarmed people studying this topic.

“I’m really scared, and I’m struggling in my own life to sort of compartmentalize what I learned, what I know, what I understand, what I see happening around me,” says filmmaker Daniel Roher. He began work on The AI Doc as he was about to become a father and wondered what kind of world his children would inherit.

We also speak with Tristan Harris, co-founder of the Center for Humane Technology, a leading AI safety advocate who is featured in the film. He says part of the risk of AI development is that it has the logic of an “arms race,” with companies and countries racing to gain supremacy rather than building guardrails.

title: Emme taida päästä eläkkeelle ikinä
content:
Valtiovarainministeriön virkamiehillä on meille asiaa.

Asia ei suinkaan ole ennenkuulumaton, sillä tätä levyä on soitettu lähes puhki varsin pitkään: eläkeikää pitäisi heidän mukaansa jälleen nostaa. Uusi maaginen vanhuuseläkeiän alaraja olisi 70 vuotta.

Myös pääministeri Petteri Orpo väläytteli eläkeiän nostoa ihan äskettäin.

VM:n strategia- ja tutkimusjohtaja Olli Kärkkäinen tähdentää Ylellä (7.10.2026), että nyt panoksia täytyisi ladata esimerkiksi työurien pidentämiseen tai pienten lasten vanhempien työllisyyteen. Hänen mukaansa näihin ei ole vähään aikaan uudistuksia tehty.

Itse muistelen kuulleeni varsinkin tätä eläkeiän nostohokemaa aika monta vuotta, ja onpa eläkeikää vuosien saatossa nostettukin useasti. Ystävieni kesken olemme jo pitkään vitsailleet, ettemme pääse eläkkeelle ikinä.

Viime helmikuussa Eläketurvakeskus ETK kertoi, että vuonna 2025 suomalaiset siirtyivät eläkkeelle keskimäärin 63-vuotiaina. Luku on toki noussut ilahduttavasti vuodesta 2009, jolloin keskiarvo pyöri vielä vajaassa 60 vuodessa.

Silti 63-vuotiaasta on aikamoinen harppaus kyetä työskentelemään 70 ikävuoteen asti.

title: It's DAF Day! Wait...What's a DAF?
content:
Today is DAF Day! This event highlights the millions of donor-advised funds (DAFs) people have set up to make charitable donations and change the world. If you have a DAF, consider supporting EFF today.

Decisions about your privacy, encryption, artificial intelligence, online speech, and digital security will determine whether technology empowers people or concentrates power in the hands of a few. A grant from your DAF to EFF supports our mission to ensure that technology remains a force for freedom, innovation, and human rights.    

If you’ve never heard of a DAF, just think of it as a bank account for your giving with some special benefits. 

Grants from DAFs allow you to: 

  • Simplify your taxes by receiving an upfront single deduction for your multiple charitable donations 
  • Receive immediate tax benefits of multi-year gifts
  • Avoid capital gains tax on long-term appreciated assets like stocks
  • Boost your giving by investing your DAF funds 

    • While allowing EFF to: 

  • Defend encryption, privacy, and security that protect users and developers 
  • Challenge unlawful surveillance and censorship that threaten democracy 
  • Shape technology policy to safeguards civil liberties while enabling innovation

title: The Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA) represents everything that’s wrong with Europe’s approach to digital sovereignty
content:
The EU’s Tech Sovereignty Package is supposed to jump-start Europe’s “sovereign AI” ambitions. But due to fundamental misunderstandings about the technology behind ‘AI’ and the blind trust in Big Tech’s AI doomer and boomer narratives, it is more likely to instead hurt digital rights and the environment instead, and waste valuable public resources that should have been invested in actually increasing Europe’s digital resilience. The Cloud and AI Development (CADA) Act, a part of the Tech Sovereignty Package, adds up to an aggressive policy push to impose “European AI”.

title: The vote is harder to steal, but politics remains hard to change
content:
Bosnia and Herzegovina’s general elections on 4 October produced an unusual result: the country has taken a significant step forward in how votes are cast and counted, without fundamentally changing who holds political power. The familiar names remain at the centre. The Serb nationalist Alliance of Independent Social Democrats (SNSD), led by the pro-Russian separatist leader Milorad Dodik, retains its dominant position in the Republika Srpska, the Bosnian entity, ; the Croat nationalist party Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina (HDZ BiH) is set to regain the Croat seat in the three-member Presidency; and the Social Democratic Party of Bosnia and Herzegovina (SDP BiH) has retained the Bosniak seat through Denis Bećirović.

Meanwhile, politics in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina has become more fragmented, with the centre-right Party for Bosnia and Herzegovina (SBiH) making a strong comeback.

title: Niger’s Junta Tightens Its Grip on Free Expression
content:
A lawyer in Niger faces prosecution over comments about the army on social media while a prominent journalist and critic of the country’s military junta is being held in secret, with authorities refusing to identify his alleged offense. These cases together highlight a broadening crackdown in Niger, where the space for free expression is shrinking by the day.

On September 21, police summoned Abrourahamane Lirwana, a well-known lawyer. A prosecutor in Niger’s capital, Niamey, charged him with “spreading data likely to disturb public order” under a broad cybercrime law and ordered him detained. Authorities have not explained the basis for the charge, though it appears linked to a September 12 Facebook post in which Lirwana described Niger’s army as divided, with some officers backing former President Mahamadou Issoufou and others former President Mohamed Bazoum. At an October 6 court hearing, prosecutors sought a five-year prison sentence for Lirwana.

title: Breaking the Cycle of Violence
content:
By David L. Phillips*

OXFORD, UK | 8 October 2026 (IDN) — Israel colluded with Hamas for decades, seeing it as a counterweight to Fatah and the Palestinian Authority. Israel’s approach culminated in the terror attack on October 7, 2023 that killed 1,200 Israelis and 252 hostages.

Does Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu bear responsibility for the strategic calculation of colluding with Hamas and the subsequent events? Israeli voters will decide when parliamentary elections are held on October 27.  The outcome will not only determine Israel’s governing coalition. It will also shape society and the future of Israeli democracy for years to come.

Israel made the strategic decision to support the Muslim Brotherhood and Sheikh Ahmed Yassin in the 1970s. However, Yassin’s network of Islamic Schools, mosques and clubs morphed into the Islamic Resistance Movement and the al-Qassam brigades. By encouraging conservative Islamic movements as an alternative to the secular PLO, Israeli authorities had te false hope of weakening Fatah’s nationalist appeal.

Kuvataiteilija Laura Kärjen (s. 1978, Lahti) yksityisnäyttelyssä inhimillinen ilmaisu kohtaa materiaalien ja värien rikkauden. Furry Darlings in Fall esittelee sekä tuftattuja teoksia että tekstiiliä ja keramiikkaa yhdistäviä veistoksia galleristi Veikko Halmetojan kuratoimana kokonaisuutena. Kärjen luomat ’pörröiset kullanmurut’ tuovat pehmeää vastavirtaa Orimattilan Taidemuseon syksyyn.

Laura Kärki rakentaa anarkistista maailmaa, jossa fantasiaolentojen edesottamukset sekä röyhkeä poseeraaminen kääntävät ilmeen virneeksi. Mustekalaisä, punkkaripapukaija ja identiteettikriisiä elävä kissa taipuvat sekä sarjakuvamaisiksi kuviksi että muodoltaan ekspressiivisiksi veistoksiksi.

Berliinissä asuva ja työskentelevä Kärki on jo aiemmin tunnettu lukuisten eri tekniikoiden taitajana. Hän maalaa, valokuvaa, kirjoittaa, rakentaa keramiikkaveistoksia ja tekee tekstiiliteoksia. title: Georgia Scraps Offshore Intermediary in Azerbaijani Power Imports
content:
Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze announced that Georgia will eliminate intermediary companies from its electricity imports from neighboring Azerbaijan, a move he said would save the state millions of dollars annually.

The trade has long been plagued by a lack of transparency, with power purchases between the two South Caucasus nations funneled almost entirely through opaque offshore companies, as previously reported by OCCRP and its regional partners. For years, the dominant player in the trade was Sulkhan Papashvili, an influential Georgian businessman.

“Having an intermediary meant additional costs for the state,” Kobakhidze said during a recorded cabinet meeting. “Specifically in the case of Azerbaijan, as a result of removing the intermediary, the state will receive several million annually.”

In 2020, Studio Monitori, OCCRP’s Georgian member center, reported that ordinary Georgians were paying inflated rates for Azerbaijani power due to the middleman arrangement — at the time handled by a Belize-registered firm, Elgreen Holdings.

title: 7 Tips from Edgar Allan Poe on How to Write Vivid Stories & Poems
content:
There may be no more a macabrely misogynistic sentence in English literature than Edgar Allan Poe’s contention that “the death… of a beautiful woman” is “unquestionably the most poetical topic in the world.” (His perhaps ironic observation prompted Sylvia Plath to write, over a hundred years later, “The woman is perfected / Her dead / Body wears the smile of accomplishment.”) The sentence comes from Poe’s 1846 essay “The Philosophy of Composition,” and if this work were only known for its literary fetishization of what Elisabeth Bronfen calls “an aesthetically pleasing corpse”—marking deep anxieties about both “female sexuality and decay”—then it would indeed still be of interest to feminists and academics, though not perhaps to the average reader.

But Poe has much more to say that does not involve a romance with dead women. The essay delivers on its title’s promise. It is here that we find Poe’s famous theory of what good literature is and does, achieving what he calls “unity of effect.” This literary “totality” results from a collection of essential elements that the author deems indispensable in “constructing a story,” whether in poetry or prose, that produces a “vivid effect.”

title: Club Med, a Disney Cruise and an Exploding Starship: SpaceX Used Bystander Videos to Track Falling Debris
content:
When SpaceX’s giant Starship rocket exploded over the Caribbean last year, the internet lit up with videos from airline passengers, island tourists and locals showing flaming debris shooting across the sky. Even some airline pilots recorded the fiery aftermath as planes scrambled to move out of its path.

Some of those videos of Starship’s seventh test flight — including ones taken from Disney and Royal Caribbean cruise ships and a Club Med resort — went on to play a role in the company’s efforts to count and track pieces of debris after the explosion, a report obtained by ProPublica says.

The report — obtained by ProPublica from the Federal Aviation Administration through a freedom of information request — shows video captured a fireball, then a shower of sparkling debris in the sky moments after the explosion. It includes maps pinpointing where the images were shot, which helped the company understand how debris tumbled to earth after the blast.

“At 1 minute 42 seconds, the debris cloud is observed transiting behind the cruise ship,” says the report, which SpaceX provided the FAA two weeks after the so-called mishap.

title: Anne Carson wins Nobel prize in literature – how she discovered new possibilities within language
content:
For over four decades, Anne Carson has been quietly redrawing the map of contemporary literature. Poet, translator, classicist, essayist, performer and visual artist, she has produced a body of work that refuses easy categorisation.

Yet what is most striking about Carson, the 2026 Nobel prize winner in literature, is not her formal originality, extraordinary though that is. It is her ability to make thinking itself like a literary event.

At a time when scholarship and creative writing are often treated as separate pursuits, Carson has shown how deeply they belong together. Her work is a reminder that thought and imagination don’t compete with one another, but continually enrich each other. The result is a body of writing that is at once intellectually demanding and creatively daring.

Carson moves effortlessly between ancient and modern worlds, not by collapsing historical difference but by inhabiting it. In her hands, antiquity is never a repository of cultural authority or a storehouse of exemplary texts. It is a living, unsettled terrain of voices, fragments, silences and absences.

title: Tunturiluonto muuttuu hälyttävää vauhtia: sammalet ja jäkälät uhattuina
content:
Turun ja Oulun yliopiston tutkijat ovat todenneet, että Käsivarren erämaa-alueella sijaitsevan Ritničohkka-tunturin kasvillisuus on muuttunut. He vertasivat tunturin nykyistä lajistoa vuonna 1990 tehtyyn kartoitukseen. Uusi otanta tehtiin vuonna 2022.

Kasvillisuuskartoitusten ja satelliittikuvatulkinnan perusteella sekä kasviyhteisöt että lumiolot ovat toisenlaisia. Väitöskirjatutkija Inka Kuusisto kertoo Turun yliopiston tiedotteessa, että tunturipaljakan kasviyhteisöjen kokonaislajimäärä ei ole muuttunut, mutta lajisto on toinen kuin 32 vuotta sitten.

Putkilokasvien kokonaislajimäärä alueella on kasvanut. Kosteisiin oloihin sopeutuneet ruohot ja heinät ovat yleistyneet tunturipaljakalla. Sammalten kokonaislajimäärä on sen sijaan pienentynyt. Häiriöön sopeutuneet lajit, jotka leviävät ensimmäisinä paljaalle maalle, ovat yleistyneet, kun taas monet tunturipaljakalle tyypilliset sammallajit ovat harvinaistuneet.

Jäkälien lajisto on vaihtunut. Poron laidunnukselle herkät jäkälälajit ovat harvinaistuneet, ja monet pienikokoiset rupijäkälät ovat yleistyneet.

”Etenkin monet tunturipaljakalle erityisistä sammalista ja jäkälistä ovat uhattuina”, Kuusisto sanoo.

title: "She Put Her Body on the Line": Maricarmen, 87, Dies; Her Eviction Sparked Spain Housing Protests
content:
The 87-year-old pensioner in Spain whose eviction from her lifelong home sparked nationwide protests has died. María del Carmen Abascal, better known as Maricarmen, died on Wednesday just hours before she was set to sign a new rental agreement. She was forcibly removed from her Madrid apartment last month on a stretcher after the private investment company that owns the building hiked her rent. After massive public outcry, the landlord had agreed to allow her back into her apartment.

Independent Spanish journalist María Carrión says that although Maricarmen’s story galvanized much of the country, evictions like hers are “a daily occurrence” in Spain.

“Rents have gone up 80% in the last 10 years, while salaries have not kept up,” Carrión says. “Young people cannot leave their homes. They cannot become independent or start families. And this is what people are trying to change from the street.”

title: Dagbani Wikimedians User Group Hosts the Language Diversity Conference 2026 in Ghana
content:
When the Language Diversity Conference 2026 opened in Accra on 2 October, it was more than just another international Wikimedia event for the Dagbani Wikimedians User Group (DWUG). It was an opportunity to welcome language activists, researchers, educators, Wikimedia contributors, and language communities from different parts of the world to Ghana.

The conference was hosted by Wikitongues and the Wikimedia Language Diversity Hub, in collaboration with the Dagbani Wikimedians User Group as the local host in Ghana, with Wikimedia UK serving as the program lead.

For DWUG, being part of the organization of the conference was both a responsibility and an opportunity to showcase the work that language communities in Ghana have been doing.

The choice of Ghana as the first host of the Global Language Diversity Conference was also meaningful. Ghana already has active communities working around different languages, and Dagbani is one of the languages with an established Wikimedia community. The conference brought 82 languages into one space and brought together more than 100 participants over three days.

title: The missing engine of Europe’s renewal
content:
From climate collapse and industrial stagnation to popular discontent and the rise of authoritarianism, our democratic future and social fabric are under unprecedented strain. The report commissioned by the Spanish government, Two Promises to Those Who Work: Voice and Ownership, delivers a clear diagnosis: our societies face nine interrelated crises, from ecological overshoot and the disruptive rise of AI to the erosion of trust in institutions and predatory financialisation.

The insight that can give hope is that the various crises share a single common denominator: an extractivist corporate model that treats workers as disposable resources rather than citizens. Extending the democratic project into the economy by recognising workers’ access to voice and ownership – the two pillars of economic democracy – is the only structural antidote to a trend that will otherwise destroy political democracy.

title: Attorney Bahareh Aghaei Sentenced to 20 Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, attorney Bahareh Aghaei has been sentenced to prison.

Based on information received by HRANA, Aghaei was recently sentenced to 20 years in prison by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Iman Afshari, on charges including “propaganda activities against national security,” under Article 4 of the Law on Intensifying Punishments for Crimes Against National Security.

Bahareh Aghaei was arrested following the January 2026 protests and subsequently transferred to Qarchak Prison in Varamin. During her detention, she was held in solitary confinement at the prison for at least 15 days.

Bahareh Aghaei is a licensed attorney and a student of international law at the University of Tehran.

title: Louisiana Activists Draw Links Between Petrochemical, Climate Harm to Maternal Health
content:
Louisiana feminist activists came together on October 2 at the annual Black Birth Matters conference to demand that policy makers consider how toxic air pollution and other environmental damage negatively impact reproductive health.

As part of a day-long examination of human rights in Louisiana, Kaitlyn Joshua, an environmental and reproductive rights expert, Shamell Lavigne from RISE St James, a key community-based environmental rights organization, and Tyra Gross, an academic with an interest in climate intersections with Black reproductive justice, led a panel on environmental justice. Joshua and Lavigne explained why industrial regulation is important for human and, specifically, maternal health, and Gross discussed ways communities can make sure pregnant people and new parents are better prepared for climate disaster.

title: Pimeän viikonlopun huumoripläjäys tuo Ali Jahangirin Hankoon
content:
Hangon Pimeän viikonlopun ohjelmassa nauretaan jälleen Ali Jahangirin seurassa. Viime vuoden tapaan Jahangiri nousee lavalle 24.10.2026 klo 19 Hangon kaupungintalon juhlasalissa osana Naurattamisen ilosta -stand up -kiertuettaan.

Viime vuonna Hangossa nähtiin show, jossa myös lavarekvisiitta sai osansa koomikon käsittelystä. Jahangiri oli toivonut esitykseensä tyylikästä baarijakkaraa, mutta lavalle päätyikin parhaat päivänsä nähnyt porrasjakkara. Siitä tuli illan yksi odottamattomista päähenkilöistä – ja samalla päästiin pohtimaan, miten Hangolla oikein menee. Ainakin yleisöllä meni hyvin: naurua riitti.

Tänä syksynä Jahangiri kiertää ympäri Suomea Naurattamisen ilosta -show’llaan. Hangon illassa on luvassa lennokkaita juttuja, yllätyksiä ja vatsanväänteitä – nimittäin naurusta. Luvassa on sopiva sekoitus tuttua ja uutta, lempeää ja tulista.

Jahangiri tunnetaan suorasta ja pelottomasta komiikastaan. Hän osaa nauraa paitsi itselleen myös muille, eikä yleisöäkään jätetä illan aikana sivustakatsojaksi. Jutut etenevät vauhdilla, eikä komiikka himmaa edes mutkissa.

Valmistaudu iltaan, jossa mikään aihe ei ole täysin turvassa.

Keikan ikäraja on 18 vuotta.

title: Police Say Scam Center Busted in PNG Had Moved from Cambodia
content:
A suspected online scam operation that was raided by police in Papua New Guinea last month is believed to have relocated to the Pacific island country in response to a crackdown on online fraud in Cambodia, local police have told OCCRP.

So far four Chinese citizens have been charged with human trafficking offences over the alleged scam center, which operated out of a luxury residential complex in PNG’s capital, Port Moresby. Police rescued 39 Indonesian workers in the raid who are suspected of being held against their will.

The suspected Port Moresby scam operation is the first of its kind in Papua New Guinea, a resource-rich but underdeveloped country of 11 million people. Experts have warned that small and poor states across the globe are at risk of turning into new bases for Asian syndicates that profit from the world’s $1 trillion a year online scam industry.

Cambodia has for years served as a center for massive scam compounds, many of which rely on trafficked workers, but international pressure since late last year has led the country’s authoritarian government to turn against the illicit industry. Thousands of scam operators have since left the country.

title: American Academy of Pediatrics Renews Call for Ban on Raw Milk
content:
The nation’s largest professional group of pediatricians has renewed its call for a nationwide ban on the sale and distribution of unpasteurized milk and other raw dairy products, according to a policy statement it published earlier this week. 

The revised guidance from the American Academy of Pediatrics warns of the serious health risks from consuming raw dairy products, particularly for children, as well as pregnant and immunocompromised people.

“More and more people are discussing this as a potentially healthful thing to do, when in fact it’s a highly risky thing to do,” said the academy’s president, Dr. Andrew Racine. “So our responsibility, as the leading voice of pediatric healthcare in the United States that’s dedicated to the health and well-being of children, is to make sure that the accurate, evidence-based information is out there.”

title: Tutkimuksen mukaan Volvot tarjoavat yhtä hyvää suojaa sekä naisille että miehille
content:
Volvo Cars on pitkään kehittänyt autoja, jotka ovat yhtä turvallisia sekä naisille että miehille. Vuosikymmenien tutkimustyöhön perustuvan uuden raportin mukaan Volvo-autot ovat suojanneet naisia ja miehiä tasa-arvoisesti jo 1970-luvulta lähtien. Tutkimuksessa korostetaan, kuinka Volvo on järjestelmällisesti kehittänyt turvallisuutta kaikille jo viiden vuosikymmenen ajan tosielämän onnettomuuksista kerättyä tietoa hyödyntäen.

Volvon turvallisuuskeskuksen laatima tutkimus haastaa pitkäikäisen oletuksen siitä, että autot eivät ole luonnostaan yhtä turvallisia naisille ja miehille. Se osoittaa, että tasa-arvoinen suojaus voidaan saavuttaa tietoihin ja tosielämän onnettomuuksiin perustuvalla turvallisuuskehityksellä.

Vertailtaessa Volvon automalleja vuosilta 2010–2019 vuosien 1970–1979 malleihin voidaan havaita, että kuljettajien kokonaisloukkaantumisriski on pienentynyt 79 prosenttia. Naisilla vähennys on vielä suurempi, 88 prosenttia, mikä laskee yleisen loukkaantumisriskin samalle tasolle miesten kanssa.

title: Ikivanha pitsinnypläys taipui älytekstiileihin – tutkijat kehittivät ympäristöön reagoivia rakenteita
content:
Ikivanhaa käsityömenetelmää pitsinnypläystä, aktiivisia materiaaleja ja tietokonemallinnusta soveltava tutkimus on kehittänyt tekstiilirakenteita, jotka muuttavat muotoaan ympäristön muuttuessa. Havaintoa voitaisiin hyödyntää esimerkiksi täysin tekstiilipohjaisen transistorin rakentamisessa, ja soveltaa vaikka maaperän kosteuden säätelyssä tai teknisissä vaatteissa, Aalto-yliopiston Kemian ja materiaalitieteen laitoksen tiedotteessa kerrotaan.

Pitsinnypläyksessä yksittäisten lankojen kulkua voidaan ohjata tarkasti. Ne voivat mutkitella rakenteessa ja muodostaa monimutkaisiakin kuvioita. Nypläystekniikan avulla tutkijat voivat valmistaa aktiivisia materiaaleja, jotka pystyvät reagoimaan esimerkiksi lämpötilan muutoksiin.

”Nypläys mahdollistaa sen, että jokaista lankaa voidaan kontrolloida yksitellen. Se antaa meille mahdollisuuden tehdä sellaisia tekstiilirakenteita, joita perinteisillä kudonta- ja neulontatekniikoilla ei voisi toteuttaa”, kertoo väitöskirjatutkija Maija Vaara tiedotteessa.

title: China’s crackdown on house churches: An interview with Su Ziming, wife of detained Chinese pastor Wang Lin
content:
On 9 October 2025, Pastor Wang Lin was taken away by police during a crackdown on Zion Church. Zion Church is a “house church” – in other words, one of the primarily protestant churches in China that operate independently of the state-approved religious system and therefore lack official registration. Wang Lin’s case highlights ongoing concerns about religious freedom for independent Christian communities in China. In the months that followed Wang’s arrest, his wife Su Ziming and their young son and daughter endured constant surveillance and harassment, restrictions on their ability to leave China, and prolonged family separation. Today, Su and her children live in the United States, while her husband remains detained in China.

Here, Su tells Amnesty International how the crackdown changed the course of her family’s life and describes the wider repression faced by China’s “house churches” and its faith-based communities.

title: Watch Footage of the Flock Search a Judge Ruled Unconstitutional
content:
Body camera footage obtained by 404 Media reveals the first Flock camera searches ruled unconstitutional by a federal judge, and highlights how the system has turned otherwise mundane traffic stops into interrogations for drivers.

On Friday, we reported that a federal judge ruled the use of license plate reader systems in the arrest of a woman named Melissa Kyle to be an “unconstitutional warrantless search,” “indiscriminate mass surveillance,” and a violation of the driver’s Fourth Amendment rights. The judge in that case ruled that, even though Kyle had more than 91 pounds of meth in her vehicle, the police had no justifiable reason to search Flock for her license plate and no reason to suspect that her travel as shown on Flock’s system was suspicious. Therefore, all of the evidence from Flock and the search of her vehicle must be thrown out.

The body camera and in-vehicle footage, alongside records from Flock and the Motorola ALPR system obtained by 404 Media shows how the use of license plate reader systems is being used to create probable cause where a person’s driving patterns are suspicious enough to pull them over.

title: Arviointineuvosto: Rajan, tullin ja poliisin tiedusteluvaltuuksissa on yhteinen pulma
content:
Lainsäädännön arviointineuvoston mielestä Rajavartiolaitoksen rikostiedustelua koskevan lakiesityksen kokonaisvaikutuksia tulisi arvioida yhdessä muiden viranomaisten valtuuksien muutoksen kanssa.

Lakiuudistuksessa rajavartiolaitos saisi muun muassa luvan käyttää kotirauhan ja luottamuksellisen viestin suojaan puuttuvia rikostiedustelukeinoja. Tämän uudistuksen vaikutusten arviointi on neuvoston mielestä hoidettu hyvin.

Samaan aikaan valtiolla on kuitenkin vireillä muidenkin turvallisuusviranomaisten tiedusteluoikeuksien laajennuksia, ja näiden yhteismuutoksen seuraukset ovat osittain vielä hämärän peitossa.

Arviointineuvoston mielestä ainakin poliisin, Rajavartiolaitoksen ja Tullin rikostiedustelua koskevien uudistusten yhteisvaikutuksia tulisi arvioida kootusti ja kokonaisuutena.

ARVIOINNISSA TULISI neuvoston mielestä tutkia, millaisia yhteisvaikutuksia kaikkien eri toimijoiden uusilla valtuuksilla on esimerkiksi perus- ja ihmisoikeuksiin tai tuomioistuinten kuormittumiseen.

Myös viranomaisten keskinäinen työn- ja vastuunjako pitää neuvoston mielestä vielä selvittää, sekä luoda uudistuksille seurantamenetelmiä.

title: My first in-person Wikimania: reflections, lessons and outcomes
content:
Wikimania 2026 in Paris was my first in-person Wikimania since I joined the Wikimedia movement in 2021. Since then, I had participated in Wikimania virtually. While virtual participation makes it possible to connect with Wikimedians from around the world, attending in person offered a completely different experience. I attended Wikimania 2026 as a recipient of a Wikimedia Foundation scholarship.

Getting to Paris was not without its challenges. My initial visa application was rejected, and I was unsure whether I would be able to attend Wikimania 2026. However, the encouragement and support I received from friends within the Wikimedia Community User Group Uganda gave me the confidence to apply again. I resubmitted my visa application, and thankfully, it was approved, allowing me to experience Wikimania 2026 in person.

title: UN Child Rights Committee Calls for Free Pre-Primary Education in Uganda
content:
The United Nations Committee on the Rights of the Child has called on Uganda to significantly expand government support for early childhood education and provide free, state-run pre-primary education to all children.

In its latest review of Uganda’s record on children’s rights, issued October 1, the Committee expressed concern about high numbers of children out of school due to financial barriers, and highlighted “very limited access to early childhood education,” especially for children in rural areas and for children with disabilities.

The Ugandan government provides free primary and secondary education, but under Uganda’s education law, pre-primary education is left to private providers, with parents responsible for the cost.

The Committee’s findings echo 2024 research by Human Rights Watch and the Initiative for Social and Economic Rights (ISER), which found that the lack of government-funded pre-primary education in Uganda leaves most young children without access to this critical stage of learning. Fewer than 1 in 10 Ugandan children ages 3 to 5 were enrolled in a registered and licensed pre-primary school, while 60 percent attended no school before entering primary school.

title: Ett humorinslag under Mörka helgen tar Ali Jahangiri till Hangö
content:
Under Mörka helgens program i Hangö får publiken återigen skratta tillsammans med Ali Jahangiri. Precis som i fjol intar Jahangiri scenen den 24 oktober 2026 kl. 19 i Hangö stadshus festsal som en del av hans stand up-turné Naurattamisen ilosta.

I fjol fick Hangö se en föreställning där även scenrekvisitan fick sin beskärda del av komikerns behandling. Jahangiri hade önskat sig en stilren barstol till föreställningen, men på scenen hamnade i stället en trappstege som sett sina bästa dagar. Den blev en av kvällens oväntade huvudpersoner, och samtidigt fick publiken fundera på hur det egentligen står till med Hangö. Åtminstone publiken hade det bra. Skratten ville aldrig ta slut.

I höst turnerar Jahangiri runt i Finland med sin Naurattamisen ilosta-show. I Hangö utlovas en kväll fylld av historier, överraskningar och magknip, av skratt förstås. Det blir en lagom blandning av något gammalt och något nytt, något mjukt och något hett.

Jahangiri är känd för sin raka och orädda komik. Han kan skratta både åt sig själv och åt andra, och publiken lämnas inte heller åt sidan under kvällen. Skämten avlöser varandra i högt tempo och komiken bromsar inte ens i kurvorna.

title: U.S. Designates China-Born Businessman in Fiji for "Significant Corruption"
content:
The U.S. State Department announced Thursday it had designated for “significant corruption” Zhao Fugang, a Chinese Communist Party-backed businessman in Fiji that OCCRP has previously revealed to be a top organized crime target of Australian law enforcement.

Zhao, a China-born Fiji citizen, is a leading member of the Pacific island country’s Chinese business community and heads the Overseas Chinese Service Center in the capital, Suva. OCCRP and Australia’s Nine media have previously reported that Australia placed the businessman on its top tier list of criminal targets in 2023 on suspicion that he is a senior member in a syndicate involved in drug smuggling, money laundering, and human trafficking.

Zhao has not been charged with a crime and no evidence has been publicly presented against him. He denies any wrongdoing.

The State Department said in a statement that Zhao had “abused his public position by paying bribes to Fijian citizens to advance China-based government, business and criminal interests.” The designation restricts Zhao or his family members from entering the U.S.

title: Metsäalan toimihenkilönaiset viihtyvät työssään, mutta kohtaavat edelleen erityisiä haasteita
content:
Metsäalan toimihenkilönaiset pitävät työtään mielekkäänä ja arvostavat erityisesti työn itsenäisyyttä, vapautta ja hyviä työyhteisöjä. Luonnonvarakeskuksen (Luke) ja Helsingin yliopiston tutkimuksessa tunnistettiin kuitenkin useita työhyvinvointia heikentäviä tekijöitä, joista osa liittyy erityisesti naisten asemaan miesvaltaisella alalla.

Laadullisessa tutkimuksessa haastateltiin syksyllä 2025 kymmenen metsätalouden eri tehtävissä työskentelevää toimihenkilönaista eri puolilta Suomea. Tutkimuksen taustalla on vuonna 2019 toteutettu puuhuoltoketjun työhyvinvointikysely (vastaajia 1282), jossa naisten työhyvinvointi osoittautui selvästi miesten työhyvinvointia heikommaksi. Tulos nosti esiin tarpeen tarkastella lähemmin erityisesti naisten työhyvinvointia ja kokemuksia miesvaltaisella alalla.

Haastattelututkimuksen mukaan metsäasiantuntijoita kuormittavat erityisesti ajoittain huomattavan suuri työmäärä, työn kausittaiset ruuhkahuiput, sekä puutteet työvälineiden toimivuudessa. Haastateltavat kokivat myös kärjistyneen julkisen metsäkeskustelun heijastuvan työn arkeen.

title: Hallitus muutti esitystään – yrittäjien eläkejärjestelmän uudistukseen toivottu muutos
content:
Yrittäjien eläkejärjestelmän (YEL) uudistukseen tulee muutos, jota yrittäjät ovat toivoneet. Osalla yrittäjistä ansiotulona voitaisiin ottaa huomioon ajantasaisempi tieto, joka on saatavilla tulorekisteristä. Heitä ovat muun muassa osakeyhtiöyrittäjät, jotka nostavat palkkaa yrityksestään.

- Haluamme tehdä yrittäjän ansiotulojen seurannasta niin reaaliaikaista kuin tällä hetkellä on mahdollista ja siksi päivitimme esitystä, sanoo sosiaaliturvaministeri Karoliina Partanen (kok.) tiedotteessa.

Hallitus antoi YEL-uudistuksesta esityksensä eduskunnalle torstaina.

ELÄKETURVAKESKUKSEN toimitusjohtaja Mikko Kautto arvioi STT:lle, että esityksen mukainen tulorekisterin hyödyntäminen koskisi potentiaalisesti noin puolta yrittäjäkunnasta.

Osakeyhtiöyrittäjien lisäksi on laskutuksen tai työsuoritteiden tekijöitä, jotka tekevät työtä yrittäjäluonteisena työnä. Osa heistä on YEL-vakuutettuja ja osa ei.

Kautto huomauttaa, että tulorekisteristä saatavat tiedot eivät nekään ole reaaliaikaisia vaan tulevat viiveellä.

KESKEISTÄ uudistuksessa on, että yrittäjällä olisi jatkossa mahdollisuus valita eläkemaksun perusteeksi myös todelliset, veronalaiset ansiotulot.

title: From Learning to Action: What I Took Away from the Interactive Media Seminar
content:
In September 2026, I had the opportunity to participate in the Interactive Media Seminar for Electoral Integrity in Abuja, Nigeria. The three-day seminar brought together participants interested in media, fact-checking, open-source information, and the fight against misinformation and disinformation. As a Wikimedia contributor, I found the training particularly relevant to the work I do on Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. It reminded me that the quality of information we share online depends greatly on how carefully we verify, evaluate, and present our sources.

One of the most important lessons I took from the seminar was the importance of checking information before sharing it. In an environment where false information can spread within minutes, especially during elections and other sensitive periods, relying on a headline, social media post, or an unverified claim is not enough.

I learned practical approaches to:

  • Verify information using reliable and independent sources.
  • Identify misleading or manipulated information.
  • Check the original source behind a claim.
  • Compare information across different sources before accepting it as accurate.

title: Death-Row Political Prisoner Barzou Rezaei Transferred to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj
content:
According to HRANA, the news agency of Human Rights Activists in Iran, Barzou Rezaei, a prisoner sentenced to death, has been transferred to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj.

According to information received by HRANA, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, Rezaei was transferred from the Greater Tehran Prison to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj without prior notice. The reasons for his transfer remain unknown.

Mr. Rezaei was recently sentenced to death by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on the charge of “collaboration with hostile governments.” The verdict was communicated to his lawyer following its issuance.

Barzou Rezaei, a resident of Kermanshah, was arrested in March 2026 in connection with the nationwide protests of January 2026. Following his arrest, he was transferred to the Greater Tehran Prison.

title: US: Deportations to African Countries Not Their Own
content:
(Washington, DC) – The Trump administration is sending hundreds of people who can’t be deported to their own countries, because of the danger they would face, to African countries where they have no connections, Human Rights Watch said in a report released today. Many have been left with no practical option but to return to their home countries regardless of the harm they face there.

US Expulsions of Third-Country Nationals to Countries in Africa

Download the full report in English

Appendix I: Third-Country Deportations by the Numbers

Appendix II: Response Letters from IOM

The 125-page report, “‘To Scare People’: US Expulsions of Third-Country Nationals to Countries in Africa,” documents that US authorities denied the more than 500 people transferred to third countries a meaningful chance to contest their removals or to articulate their fears of being removed to these countries. Some countries arbitrarily detained people they had accepted, and some have sent people onward to the risk of persecution or torture in their home countries, violating the international law principle of nonrefoulement.

title: ‘Jonathan’ Is the Oldest Land Animal on Earth. He Could Hold the Secrets to Defying Death
content:
Jonathan the tortoise, the world’s oldest living land animal, is still chugging along at the ripe age of roughly 194. Now, scientists have discovered some of the secrets to Jonathan’s longevity by sequencing his genome for the first time, according to a study published Wednesday in Science Advances.

Jonathan, a Aldabra giant tortoise (Aldabrachelys gigantea), hatched around 1832 in the Seychelles archipelago, and he was already in his twenties when Charles Darwin published On the Origin of Species. In his fifties, Jonathan was brought to the remote island of Saint Helena, along with three other tortoises, as a gift to the British colonial governor in the 1880s. He has lived there ever since. 

Aldabra giant tortoises often become centenarians, but Jonathan is a major outlier even for his species as he approaches nearly 200 years on this planet. To better understand his extreme lifespan, researchers evaluated Jonathan’s genome based on swabs of his cheeks and compared it with the genomes of several other tortoises, including a 36-year-old named Tank.

title: China Needs Russia in the Fight
content:
During a four-hour meeting in Brussels in July 2025, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reportedly told the European Union’s top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, that China could not afford a Russian defeat in Ukraine.

This was a simple power calculus: if Russia lost, the United States would be free to shift its full attention to Beijing. The remark came more than three years into the Sino-Russian “no-limits partnership” that Presidents Xi and Putin declared on the eve of the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022. The exchange, first reported by the South China Morning Post and omitted from the Chinese government’s official account of the meeting, showed how Beijing actually views the war. China has long presented itself as a neutral party interested in peace. In private, however, its foreign minister in effect acknowledged that Russia’s survival as a fighting power serves its global interests.

title: Syntymäpäiväsankari Putin 7.10.2026
content:
Julminkin hirmuhallitsija janoaa tunnustusta ja kehuja. Erityisesti syntymäpäivänään. Diktaattorin rengit ja hanslankarit tietävät sen ja pyrkivät tekemään parhaansa mairitellakseen suurta johtajaa.

Hyvänä esimerkkinä tästä sairaasta tunnustuksen tarpeesta oli Neuvostoliiton diktaattori Josif Stalin. Häntä kehuttiin yli kaikkien rajojen. Yleisimmät Stalinin kutsumanimet olivat kansojen isä (oтец народов) sekä suuri johtaja ja opettaja (Великий вождь и учитель). Neuvostolehdistössä käytettiin myös nimityksiä: isä ja ihmiskunnan suurin nero. Merkillisin näistä epiteeteistä lienee seuraava: maailman tieteen suurin korifeus (величайший корифей мировой науки ts. tulee kreikan sanasta κορυφαῖος – kärki ts. suurin kärki). Sodan jälkeen Stalinille annettiin nimitykset kaikkien aikojen ja kansojen suurin sotapäällikkö. Sekä tietysti nimitys generalissimus – kenraalien kenraali.

title: Three Years into Genocide, "The IDF Is Still Hunting Gazans": Palestinian Journalist Akram al-Satarri
content:
In Gaza, October 7, 2023, is viewed as the beginning of the genocide. Over the past three years, Israel killed over 74,000 people, according to the Gaza Health Ministry, but many believe that number is a vast undercount. The killing continues despite a so-called ceasefire that took effect about a year ago.

“Every single aspect of the life of the people of Gaza has changed once and forever,” since October 7, says Akram al-Satarri, a Gaza-based journalist. He points out that a large majority of structures in the Gaza Strip have been reduced to rubble and that Israel controls around 70% of Gaza. “The Israeli Air Force is still hovering all around different parts of the Gaza Strip, and the IDF is still hunting Gazans, disturbing the already disturbed life, spreading death and displacement once and once again.”

title: Stubb ja Espanjan kuningas: Rajamme on yhteinen
content:
Presidentti Alexander Stubb ja Espanjan kuningas Felipe painottivat EU-maiden välistä sataprosenttista solidaarisuutta ja sen merkitystä, puhuessaan Lapin yliopistolla keskiviikkona.

Stubbin mukaan EU:lla on vain yksi raja. Kuningas Felipen mukaan Espanja ja Suomi ymmärtävät jakavansa osana EU:ta yhteisen rajan huolimatta siitä, että maiden käsitykset niitä uhkaavista vaaroista eriävät toisistaan.

- Jakaminen on välittämistä, Stubb sanoi.

Stubb viittasi puheessaan muun muassa heinäkuiseen Ceutan siirtolaiskriisiin, missä tuhannet marokkolaiset tunkeutuivat Espanjalle kuuluvalle alueelle luvatta.

KUN CEUTAN tapahtumat tulivat uutisiin, EU:ssa ei kuitenkaan kuultu pelkkiä jäsenmaiden solidaarisuutta korostavia lausuntoja, vaan esimerkiksi Italia ilmoitti heinäkuun lopussa keskeyttävänsä Schengen-sopimuksen soveltamisen Espanjan kanssa.

Myös sisäministeri Mari Rantanen (ps.) ilmoitti tuolloin välittömästi kannattavansa ehdotusta Espanjan sulkemisesta Schengen-alueen ulkopuolelle.

KUNINGAS Felipe ja kuningatar Letizia olivat Suomessa kaksipäiväisellä vierailulla.

title: “Storms make trees take deeper roots”: The impact of Dolly Parton’s death on Wikipedia
content:
At differing times on 25 August, the world heard news they didn’t quite believe. Singer, songwriter, literacy campaigner, and overall icon Dolly Parton had died. Many of us did what we do when we want to be sure: we went to Wikipedia to verify the news. Every day, that reflex pulls hundreds of millions of readers to the site. Almost always, they arrive at Wikipedia articles that load, no matter how sudden the surge in interest. For about forty minutes on 25 August, the page did not load for some of our readers.

At around 18:18 UTC, four of the seven database servers in the Foundation’s Ashburn datacenter that hold cached versions of parsed Wikipedia pages became unavailable. Readers routed through Ashburn (much of Europe, Eastern North America and South America) saw errors and long timeouts. At its peak, MediaWiki was returning around 10,000 error responses per second.

Dolly Parton, 79, with her decades of work, was too much for any one page to hold. Editors have been trying anyway. Her English-language article had been edited more than 6,000 times before her death; volunteers made hundreds more in the hours after.

title: Israel: How the October 7 massacre saved Netanyahu
content:
Karolina Zbytniewska, FocusEurope.pl: On the anniversary of the bloody October 7 and before the Knesset elections on October 27, what is the political mood in Israel?

Joel Schalit, theBattleground.eu: October 7 is treated as the beginning of a new era – our 9/11 moment. It seemed to confirm the right’s darkest vision of Israel’s place in the Middle East and Palestinian attitudes towards Israel and Jews: the narrative Benjamin Netanyahu and his people have promoted for years. 

Netanyahu presents it as a watershed in Jewish history worldwide, extending its significance beyond the attack on Israel itself.

Discontent with him has grown, but I don’t know whether it will be enough to remove him in the October 27 elections. He has shaped Israeli politics since the early 1990s and radically transformed the country for the worse.

And here a personal disclaimer: I am and will always be part of Israel. My family came from Kharkiv and Galați in Romania during the First Aliyah and has been in the region since the 1880s. However, politically, I have never been more disenchanted with the country or Netanyahu’s role in shaping it.

title: Joint Statement by Human Rights Organizations regarding Abduction of Human Rights Defenders
content:
We, the undersigned organizations, condemn in strongest possible terms the abduction of three human rights defenders by Vietnamese authorities in Cambodia and their subsequent arbitrary detention in Vietnam.

The Vietnamese government must immediately and unconditionally release Nguyen Duc Thuan, a Norwegian citizen, Tran Hiep (Ho Pham Hiep Huy), an Australian citizen, and Thai Cong Truong Son, an ethnic Vietnamese living in Cambodia. Pending their release, Norwegian and Australian consular officials must be granted immediate access to Mr. Thuan and Mr. Hiep.

Background

Mr. Thuan and Mr. Hiep went missing on the morning of 18 September 2026 while traveling to the Kaoh Andaet area of Cambodia. For ten days, they were incommunicado.

On 28 September, Vietnam’s Ministry of Public Security announced that the three men had been caught “illegally entering Vietnam” at the My Quy Tay Border Gate on 18 September. Subsequently, the three men are currently being investigated for “terrorism”. Their families and colleagues strongly reject this account. All available information points to the fact that the men were abducted on Cambodian soil and forcibly taken across the border.

title: Africa’s governments already treat the internet as protest infrastructure. Its courts have not caught up
content:
When many people gather, some states are not prosecuting people. Instead, it cuts the network

Originally published on Global Voices

Kenya Judiciary building.  Image by Wing via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0).

This piece is part of Global Voices’ September 2026 Spotlight series, “Protest in Democracy.” With this Spotlight, we seek to explore the many forms of protest, the tactics states use to delegitimize and suppress them, and the complex relationship between protest and democracy. You can support this coverage by donating here.

On a Saturday in late July 2025, Angola shut down its internet for the first time in its recorded history. Not during an election, and not during a war. People had taken to the streets to protest the rising price of fuel. At least 22 people were killed according to the authorities’ own figures; civil society monitors counted 30 dead and more than 1,500 arrested.

title: Hundreds of Cases Opened and Indictments Issued in Connection with Two Recent Wars
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan, Judiciary spokesperson Seyed Ali Kazemi said during a press conference addressing the latest status of cases related to what he described as “actions against the country’s security and national interests” that 476 cases have so far been opened in connection with the two recent wars.

Kazemi added that proceedings in these cases are ongoing in prosecutors’ offices and courts, and that additional cases are being opened as new complaints are filed.

He continued: “So far, 163 indictments have also been issued in connection with these two wars.” In another part of his remarks, addressing cases involving allegations of collaboration with Israel and hostile countries, Kazemi said: “In this regard, 250 cases have been opened, involving 1,895 defendants.”

According to Kazemi, 94 of the defendants are media workers, while 1,801 are private individuals. The Judiciary spokesperson also announced that 70 indictments have so far been issued in connection with these individuals.

title: Countries Demonstrate Record Support for UN Sudan Probe Renewal
content:
A record number of countries at the United Nations Human Rights Council this week voted to support a resolution renewing the mandate of the UN Fact-Finding Mission for the Sudan. For the first time, the Gambia, Mauritius, and Malawi joined South Africa and countries from other regions voting in favor of the resolution.

The fact-finding mission is mandated to investigate human rights violations and abuses committed by Sudan’s warring parties and advance accountability, including by collecting and preserving evidence to identify those responsible and to use in future prosecutions.

Over the past year, the mission has presented various reports, including a special inquiry on the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) assault on El Fasher, which it concluded bore the hallmarks of genocide, as well as a recent exposé on the role of external actors in fueling the conflict. It has worked with the joint Fact-Finding Mission of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) to ensure their work is complementary.

title: Brazil’s Fateful Election
content:
By Jonathan Power

LUND, Sweden | 7 October 2026 (IDN) — Since its birth as a nation-state, “Brazil has been a paradise for some, an endless hell for others, and for the rest, a kind of purgatory on earth.” So write two Brazilian historians, Lilla Schwarcz and Heloisa Starling, in their massive volume on Brazil.

They continue: “Brazil’s development was born of ambivalence and contrast. On the one hand, it is a country with a high degree of social inequality and low literacy rates. In contrast, its electoral system is one of the most sophisticated and reliable in the world. Brazil has the second-highest number of Facebook users in the world.

“At the same time vast geographical regions lie abandoned, particularly in the north, where the chief means of transport is by rudimentary sailboats. Brazil has an advanced constitution which forbids any discrimination, yet, in reality, silent and perverse forms of prejudice are deeply ingrained and pervade everyday life. In Brazil the traditional and the cosmopolitan, the urban and the rural, the exotic and the civilised walk hand in hand. The archaic and the modern intermingle, the one questioning the other in a kind of ongoing interrogation.”

title: 5 Fixes to Copyright
content:
Today, COMMUNIA is launching fivefixes.eu, a new campaign website setting out five targeted changes to EU copyright law that could deliver significant benefits for research and innovation in Europe.

Generative AI dominates the copyright debate. Yet policymakers must also address other persistent problems that prevent Europe’s knowledge ecosystem from reaching its full potential. With the public consultation on a potential initiative for a better copyright environment for European creativity and innovation now underway, our campaign highlights practical solutions to these barriers.

A competitive European economy depends on access to high-quality knowledge resources and legal certainty for those who use them. Today, restrictive copyright rules and unfair licensing practices too often stand in the way. Our campaign focuses on five issues:

  • Barriers to sharing research data: Researchers face restrictions on sharing data with collaborators or for purposes of validation.
  • Obstacles to open access: Researchers cannot always make their publications openly available, even when their work is publicly funded.

title: Nytt läspaket gör litteraturen till en del av konfirmandundervisningen
content:
Läskunnigheten bland unga i Finland har försämrats och samtidigt läser allt färre unga skönlitteratur på sin fritid. Målet med det nya läspaketet Känn texten som delas ut bland konfirmander är att stärka ungas läskunnighet och relation till litteratur. Materialet erbjuder unga en möjlighet att ta del av olika perspektiv, dela erfarenheter, stärka sitt kritiska tänkande och ska framför allt inspirera till att läsa.

Läspaketet innehåller noveller som har beställts av fem finländska författare. De som medverkar är Juhani Karila, Kaj Korkea-aho, Vehka Kurjenmiekka, Juuli Niemi och Jyri Paretskoi.

Läspaketet publiceras på finska, svenska och som lättläst finska för att så många unga som möjligt ska kunna ta del av det.

Materialet har producerats av jubileumsårsprojektet Hjärtats bildning 750 år i samarbete med Läscentrum och med stöd av Finska kulturfonden.

”In genom porten” av Juuli Niemi är en av de fem novellerna. Huvudpersonen i den möter växtvärk och sorg mitt i förändringen med nyfamilj.

content:
Vierailin syyskuun alussa Ruotsissa Linköpingissä ja Vadstenassa, osallistuin Uppsalan yliopistossa käynnissä olevan Hus och sociala praktiker i svenska städer 1600–1850 -hankkeen järjestämään työpajaan. Työpajaan kuului tutustumista keskiajalla ja uuden ajan alussa rakennettuihin taloihin, asumisjärjestelyjen pohdintaa ja paljon kävelyä kauniin syksyisissä kaupunkimiljöissä. Ensimmäisenä päivänä vierailimme Linköpingin tuomiokirkossa.

Keskiajalla rakennetussa ja edelleen käytössä olevassa kirkossa riitti ajallisia kerrostumia tutkittavaksi, mutta huomioni kiinnittyi erityisesti lähelle kirkon kuoria lattiaan upotettuun hautalaattaan. Se erosi muodoltaan ja sisällöltään kirkon muista hautalaatoista, enkä muista nähneeni vastaavaa 1600-luvulla tehtyä hautalaattaa muissakaan kirkoissa. Laatta jakautui 23 ruutuun. Laatan yläosassa oli kolme ruutua vierekkäin. Näiden alle oli sijoitettu 20 ruutua. Jokaiseen ruutuun on kirjoitettu tietoja henkilöstä.

Hetken hautalaattaa tarkasteltuani ymmärsin, että laatan yläosaan oli kirjattu tiedot perheen isästä ja hänen kahdesta vaimostaan. Heidän alleen oli sijoitettu perheeseen syntyneet lapset.

title: Ilmastokriisi uhkaa syöstä Afrikan köyhät maat konfliktien noidankehään – Siitä kärsii myös muu maailma, varoittaa ekonomisti Edward Miguel
content:
Kun sää on lämmin tai suorastaan kuuma, ihmisille tapahtuu jotain kummallista. Se on havaittu esimerkiksi Indonesiassa, Brasiliassa ja Yhdysvalloissa: he tekevät tavallista enemmän rikoksia. 

Suurkaupungeissa taustalla voi olla esimerkiksi se, että ihmiset ovat kuumalla säällä ulkona tavallista enemmän ja kohtaavat toisiaan. Helle voi kiristää pinnaa, ja harkintakyky voi pettää. 

Ilmastonmuutoksen seurauksena vastaavista sään ääri-ilmiöistä voi kuitenkin seurata myös jotain vakavampaa: poliittista epävakautta, täysimittaisia konflikteja.  

Tutkijat ovat olleet siitä tietoisia jo pitkään, mutta uuden tutkimuksen avaintulos on se, että väkivallan riski on erityisen suuri kaikkein köyhimmissä maissa, varoittaa Kalifornian yliopiston taloustieteen professori Edward Miguel. Tutkimus keskittyy Afrikkaan. 

”Afrikka on maailman köyhin manner, ja siellä on historiallisesti eniten konflikteja. Siellä on pahimmat mahdolliset olosuhteet, ja siellä äärimmäiset sääilmiöt johtavat todennäköisimmin väkivaltaan.” 

Afrikan maat voivat jumiutua pahaan köyhyyden, väkivallan ja äärisäiden kierteeseen, mutta sitä voi myös ehkäistä, hän sanoo.

title: Ministeri Tavio osallistuu EU:n epäviralliseen kehitysministerikokoukseen
content:
EU:n kehitysministerit kokoontuvat epäviralliseen kokoukseen, joka järjestetään 8.–9. lokakuuta Dublinissa, Irlannissa. Suomea kokouksessa edustaa ulkomaankauppa- ja kehitysministeri Ville Tavio.

Kehitysministerit keskustelevat kokouksessa kehityspolitiikan tulevaisuudesta muuttuvassa kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä sekä humanitaarisen järjestelmän kohtaamista haasteista. Kokoukseen osallistuvat myös Islannin, Iso-Britannian, Kanadan ja Norjan kehitysministerit sekä YK:n hätäapukoordinaattori ja alipääsihteeri Tom Fletcher.

”Suomi on ottanut kehityspolitiikkansa keskiöön kansallisen edun näkökulman, jota voidaan laajemmin soveltaa myös EU-tasolla. Molemminpuoliseen hyötyyn perustuvaa kehityspolitiikkaa voidaan toteuttaa erityisesti kauppaa ja kehitystä yhdistämällä, joka on mahdollista muun muassa EU:n Global Gateway -hankkeiden kautta. Humanitaarisen avun kohdalla Suomi pitää tärkeänä avun perillepääsyä, etenkin pahimpien kriisien keskelle”, ministeri Tavio sanoo.

title: Azerbaijan Denies Link to Espionage Case Involving Former German Spy Chief
content:
Azerbaijan has denied a report from a German magazine that claimed a former German spy chief — arrested Tuesday on treason and espionage charges — used classified state secrets to prepare an “analysis” for Baku’s intelligence services in exchange for money.

The denial follows a Tuesday statement from Germany’s Federal Prosecutor’s Office announcing the arrest of August Hanning, who served as President of the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005. Police also arrested his former chief of staff, identified only as Manfred D.

Prosecutors accuse Hanning of procuring “nearly two thousand documents, many of which contained classified information,” with the help of Manfred D., in “exchange for payment,” from 2010 to 2022. While Hanning had by then retired from public service, Manfred D. worked as chief of staff for several subsequent BND heads from March 2012 to March 2026.

Hanning allegedly “commercially exploit[ed]” this classified information in his private consulting work. In one instance, prosecutors allege he used state secrets to draft an “analysis” for an unnamed foreign intelligence agency.

title: Why the Maps of London, Tokyo, New York, and Other Major Cities Look the Way They Do
content: If you’re trying to understand a city, its map isn’t a bad place to start. Today, of course, we can call up an accurate map of practically any part of any city at any time we like, with detailed point-to-point directions available on command. Turn on the satellite view, street view, or 3D mode with its offer of every imaginable point of view, and you soon feel you’re engaging with less a representation of the city than the city itself. Yet the familiarity this makes us feel we possess is deceptive, a realization that comes afresh whenever our phone runs out of battery, leaving us barely able to find our way through even neighborhoods we’d thought we knew. Sheer habit can get us between the places we frequent, but that’s a far cry indeed from understanding the city as a whole.

With this review, the European Commission is keeping its ambitions high, looking to overhaul key elements of the standardisation system and to make it more easily accessible to a number of stakeholders. This includes open source organisations and communities engaged in standardisation work, who will see to significantly benefit from the proposal. The revision is a welcome step in the right direction. OFE has long been actively engaged in the European discourse on standardisation and over the decades provided several contributions on improving the processes for standardisation in Europe. OFE will support the co-legislators in developing this proposal into law.

title: Alueellinen eriytyminen ei ole luonnonlaki
content:
Suomen alueelliset erot eivät synny vain toisten paikkakuntien kasvusta ja toisten väestön menetyksestä. Teoria kumulatiivisesta kausaatiosta auttaa tunnistamaan, kuinka väestön, työpaikkojen ja palvelujen muutokset vahvistavat toisiaan.

Suomi on toisistaan eriytyvien alueiden maa. Tilastokeskuksen väestötietojen mukaan Uudenmaan väkiluku kasvoi vuosina 2000–25 noin 29 prosenttia. Kainuussa väestö väheni samana aikana noin 19 prosenttia ja Etelä-Savossa 18 prosenttia. Väheneminen ja ikääntyminen painottuvat Itä-Suomeen ja muuhun harvaan asuttuun Suomeen.

Alueellista muutosta kuvataan usein sopeutumisena väestökehitykseen. Kun lasten määrä vähenee, kunta sulkee kouluja. Kun palvelujen käyttäjiä on aiempaa vähemmän, hyvinvointialue yhdistää toimipisteitä. Kun työvoima ja kysyntä vähenevät, yritykset suuntaavat investointinsa muualle.

Jokainen ratkaisu näyttää erikseen tarkasteltuna järkevältä vastaukselta muuttuneeseen tilanteeseen. Ne muuttavat kuitenkin myös seuraavien päätösten lähtökohtia.

Koulun lakkauttaminen voi heikentää alueen houkuttelevuutta lapsiperheiden silmissä. Palvelupisteen siirtäminen vähentää palvelun käyttöä, mikä puolestaan tulkitaan myöhemmin kysynnän hiipumiseksi.
